text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Mining Matters
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
For any hunter interested in
ore-based weaponry, mining's
a skill you can't afford to
do without. The first step
is to identify areas that
can be mined. If you find a
crack in a cliff or ridge,
swing that Iron Pickaxe!

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Basic Bug Hunting
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Bugs that inhabit hunting
grounds can be used in the
production or enhancement of
weaponry and armor, and for
combining. If you find bugs
buzzing around, take out a
a Bug Net and swing it to
bag them!

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Fishing Foundation
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Fish dwelling in the hunting
grounds are essential for
combining ammunition. Get a
feel for fishing so that you
can keep a cool head when
you need to cast out a line.
Time it so you reel in the
fish the instant the float
sinks.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Transportation Tutorial
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Spring is in the air, and
it's the perfect time to
gather monster eggs. Your
mission is to deliver some
Carnivore Eggs. These are
relatively easy to carry,
but you'll need to be wary
of monster attacks, and your
stamina being worn down.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Mining Matters
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
For any hunter interested in
ore-based weaponry, mining's
a skill you can't afford to
do without. The first step
is to identify areas that
can be mined. If you find a
crack in a cliff or ridge,
swing that Iron Pickaxe!

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Fishing Foundation
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Fish dwelling in the hunting
grounds are essential for
combining ammunition. Get a
feel for fishing so that you
can keep a cool head when
you need to cast out a line.
Time it so you reel in the
fish the instant the float
sinks.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Master the Flash Bomb
text.description:
You'll have nothing to fear
once you've mastered the art
of flinging a Flash Bomb in
front of a monster's eyes
and blinding them with a
powerful flash of light.
Flash Bombs can be found in
the Supply Box, so feel free
to use them at will.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Master the Flash Bomb
text.description:
You'll have nothing to fear
once you've mastered the art
of flinging a Flash Bomb in
front of a monster's eyes
and blinding them with a
powerful flash of light.
Flash Bombs can be found in
the Supply Box, so feel free
to use them at will.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Master the Flash Bomb
text.description:
You'll have nothing to fear
once you've mastered the art
of flinging a Flash Bomb in
front of a monster's eyes
and blinding them with a
powerful flash of light.
Flash Bombs can be found in
the Supply Box, so feel free
to use them at will.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Master the Shock Trap
text.description:
Set a Shock Trap or Pitfall
Trap under a monster to stop
it in its tracks. Or you can
target a monster when it's
weak, put it to sleep with a
Tranq Bomb and capture it.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Master the Shock Trap
text.description:
Set a Shock Trap or Pitfall
Trap under a monster to stop
it in its tracks. Or you can
target a monster when it's
weak, put it to sleep with a
Tranq Bomb and capture it.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Master the Shock Trap
text.description:
Set a Shock Trap or Pitfall
Trap under a monster to stop
it in its tracks. Or you can
target a monster when it's
weak, put it to sleep with a
Tranq Bomb and capture it.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Velocidrome Territory
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Velocidrome will flee to
a different area and lay low
to recover its health. While
it may be the perfect foe to
measure your hunting skills
against, its minions -- the
Velociprey -- are out in
force so be careful.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
The Twin Blue Shadows
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Hunt the two Velocidromes
feeding in the Jungle. They
make ideal foes to get you
in the hunting mood. It's
a perfect time to take them
on, as their minions, the
Velociprey, are thin on the
ground this season.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Bag the Boar Boss
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Bulldrome, the mighty
leader of the Bullfangos,
makes regular appearances
in the Jungle. It's a tough
opponent, so using items
like a Shock Trap to catch
it instead of killing it
could be a good plan.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Bag the Boar Boss
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Bulldrome, leader of
the Bullfangos, is a tough
customer on an old-fashioned
rampage. This cold weather
has made him ravenous, no
doubt. If things get out of
hand, why not just catch and
deliver the Goldenfish?

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Follow the Yian Kut-Ku's Cry
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
If ever you hear a curious
birdlike cry in the Jungle,
it's sure to be the creature
known as the Yian Kut-Ku. If
you manage to hunt one, you
can consider yourself quite
the skilled hunter. Make a
sound by its ears and it may
shed some tears…

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Blue Yian Kut-Ku Sighted
text.description:
If ever you hear a curious
birdlike cry in the Jungle,
it's sure to be the creature
known as the Yian Kut-Ku. A
Yian Kut-Ku normally has a
pink body, but this one is
rumored to be blue. Could be
an intriguing subspecies...

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Follow the Yian Kut-Ku's Cry
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
You'll be quite the Hunter
if you succeed in bagging
the Yian Kut-Ku! If you have
a free moment, you can even
try ripening some mushrooms!
Just put a Unique Mushroom
into a Maka Pot and bury it
in the ground! Easy, right?

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
The Daimyo of the Shore
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
It's said the Daimyo emerges
on the shore at this time of
year. Its body is protected
by a hard carapace, making
damaging it difficult. You
can get Carapaceon Brains
from his minions.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Venomous Storm
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
We are in something of a
pickle. Two Gypceros have
appeared in the Jungle, one
black, the other a purple
sub-species. Even normally
unflappable hunters are
balking at the thought of
taking them both on. Are
you up to the task?

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Congalala's Turf
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Congalala is a Fanged
Beast with a fondness for
fungus, a taste shared by
its minions, the Congas.
If you'd like to make its
acquaintance, try stocking
up on Unique Mushrooms.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Congalala's Turf
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Don't let the Congalala's
odd behavior throw you. You
may think it's preparing to
chow down during battle,
only to find it flying into
a tantrum, or even pooping
on you. Don't be alarmed,
that's just how it marks
its turf...

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
What a Whopper!
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Word has reached us of two
piscines lurking beneath the
water near the Jungle. One
of them is said to striking
green scales. Is there any
brave soul ready to confirm
the rumors?

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
The Queen's Domain
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Countless hunters have bowed
before the Rathian, which is
how it earned the nickname
of "Queen of the Land". Hunt
down this regal beast, and
you'll prove yourself once
and for all to be a true
hunter.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Royal Procession
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Royal visitors have arrived
in the Jungle, but this is
no cause for celebration.
Two monstrous Queens are
there, one clad in lustrous
green, one in vivid pink.
Who will dare to face them?

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
The Queen's Domain
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Announce your arrival on the
hunting scene by hunting the
Rathian. She isn't called a
Queen for nothing. If you
don't feel up to the task,
try snatching some Wyvern
Eggs instead.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Leaping Lizards
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Desert is aswarm with
Genprey, led by the bulky,
razor-clawed Gendrome.
Should hunting this beast
prove a problem, focus on
getting a Blooming Cactus
by placing a Cactus Flower
in a Maka Pot instead.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Leaping Lizards
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Guild is seeking hunters
to track down the fearsome
Gendrome. And if you've got
spare time, 'tis the season
for Herbivore Eggs. These
nourishing eggs are firm
favorites of merchants and
gourmets everywhere.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
The Swimming Sand Wyverns
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Hunting the Cephalos that
swim freely through the
sand isn't easy. Battling
their boss, the Cephadrome,
will take every ounce of
perseverance you have. You
need to lure it to the
surface with a loud noise
or shock.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
The Dust Cloud Fortress
text.description:
If you're taking aim at the
Daimyo Hermitaur, bear in
mind that it's very fond of
burrowing beneath the sand.
When it hardens its defense,
it becomes nigh invincible.
They don't call it the
"Shield Crab" for nothing.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
The Underwater Jade
text.description:
This is the season when a
Plesioth subspecies with a
striking jade body is known
to appear in the Desert.
Hunting it is no easy task,
and you'll need to make a
loud noise to draw it from
the water.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Lurking in the Deep
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
It's highly probable that
the Plesioth is hunting
prey by the waterside. When
fishing out a Plesioth with
a Frog, the fewer hunters
involved, the better. If
others are with you, get
them to leave the area,
and face the beast alone.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Desert Sakura
text.description:
We've received reports of
a brilliant pink-colored
Rathian in the Desert.
Anyone who thinks they have
what it takes to hunt this
extremely rare subspecies
should make themselves
known at the Quest Counter!

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Battle with Brutality
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Diablos's viciousness
sets it apart from most
Desert dwellers. Get on
the wrong end of its
charge, and it may be the
last mistake you make.
Breaking its horns can
also bring victory.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Four Horns
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
A vile and vicious Diablos
with a blackened body has
been spotted. And what's
worse, it has company. Does
any hunter dare to face two
pairs of murderous horns?

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Red Venom Ruler
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Ioprey are stirring, and
it may well mean that their
leader, the Iodrome, is in
the vicinity. A direct hit
from its venomous spit could
prove fatal, so don't forget
to pack plenty of antidotal
items.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Red Venom Ruler
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Iodrome's devastating
blows leave the Velocidrome
and Gendrome in the shade.
If you sense danger, focus
on gathering the mushrooms
found in the swamp instead.
You could also try maturing
them in a Maka Pot.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
The Reckless Razorback
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The swamp's the environment
best-suited to Bullfangos.
For those hunters planning
to face the Bulldrome, we
ask that you also slay as
many Bullfangos as possible.
Needless to say, a reward
will be provided.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Avian Menaces
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
We've received word of bird-
like cries echoing through
the Marshlands. The Yian Kut
-Ku is the likely culprit,
and there may be more than
one. This Quest is not for
the faint-hearted. But some
brave soul will step up,
right...?

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Toxic Threat
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Gypceros is a toxic
bird, unaffectionately
dubbed the "Foul Fowl."
A ferocious, flapping
beast with a nasty line
in venomous spit, it's
not a complete birdbrain,
and can play dead when it
feels threatened.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
The Purple Peril
text.description:
A Gypceros subspecies has
appeared in the swamp, and
its body is apparently an
eerie shade of purple. It
has a habit of collecting
shiny objects, so you may
be rewarded with a precious
stone if you manage to
break its crown.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Toxic Threat
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Gypceros is a toxic
bird, unaffectionately
dubbed the "Foul Fowl."
It boasts not only a nasty
line in toxic spit, but can
also fire deadly beams of
light. Word is that smashing
its crown can put an end to
its little light show.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Cream & Crimson
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
It seems two shadows have
been seen slithering in the
darkness. The white shadow
has been identified as a
Khezu, while the red one
as its subspecies. Hunters
who have the guts to face
this electric duo should
come to the Quest Counter!

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Queen of the Swamp
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
All hunters know that if you
bag yourself a Rathian, you
can hold your head high as
the real deal. Just think of
the respect you'd earn if
you could reduce this regal
beast to tears! Maybe you'd
have to pluck a nose hair...

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
The Shogun Swamp Lurker
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
While the Daimyo has strong
defense, the Shogun excels
in offense. A single slice
from its claws can shred all
before it. If hunting it
proves too tough, destroy
its claws and flee.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
The Shogun Swamp Lurker
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Shogun Ceanataur's
vicious, razor-sharp claws
have earned it the nickname
of the "Scythe Crab." In
other news, Sootstone Ore
can be mined in the Swamp
this season, so if you're
lucky you could get a
Lightcrystal as a reward.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Insatiable Swamp-Dweller
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
This is the season when the
Marshlands teem with Congas.
Their leader, Congalala, is
something of a lone wolf and
is so mighty, it doesn't
need to run with the rest of
the pack. Exercise extreme
caution.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Insatiable Swamp-Dweller
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
If you are hit by the dung
Congalala throws, then you
will become unable to use
recovery items. If hunting
it proves difficult, trade
the Khezu Whelps in the
ground with the Veggie Elder
and deliver what he gives
you.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Double Trouble
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
It seems the swamp has been
taken over by two Gravios,
brought by the desire for
ore. Are there any hunters
brave enough to face such
formidable foes?

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Hunting in an Arctic Land
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Don't forget to pack some
Hot Drinks before heading
to the Arctic Ridge. Why
not get acclimatized to the
frosty slopes by slaying
Popos before taking on the
Bulldrome?

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
The Red Shadow
text.description:
A red shadow's been sighted
slithering through the snow.
It's sure to be a Red Khezu.
The Blangos are searching
for food together in packs,
so take care not to run into
both beasts together.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
The White Shadow
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Khezu spend their larval
stage entirely underground,
so their sense of smell is
believed to be superior to
their eyesight. If the hunt
runs into trouble, trade the
Khezu Whelps in the ground
with the Veggie Elder and
deliver what he gives you.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Lord of the Beasts
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Arctic Ridge is overrun
with countless Blango this
season. Acting on the orders
of their leader, Blangonga,
they attack in packs. Don't
let them surround you.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
One Big Happy Family
text.description:
The Blangonga is the ruler
of the Arctic Ridge, and
will brutally attack anyone
who threatens its territory.
This may sound far-fetched,
but two of these beasts have
been sighted. Even so, are
you still up to the task?

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
The Golden Mane
text.description:
A frightful monster has been
sighted at the edge of the
arctic land. Its power is
said to be comparable only
to that of an elder dragon,
and its body gives off a
radiant golden glow. No
hunter has yet seen it and
lived to tell the tale...

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Lord of the Beasts
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Hunting the Iodrome in the
Volcano may well prove to
be a headache. When its
health is low, it has a
nasty habit of fleeing to
an inhospitable spot where
your health will be drained.
The trick is to not to let
it escape.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
The Trap Lurking in the Rock
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
If you plan to go after the
Basarios, keep a careful eye
on the rocky regions, since
it will often try to blend
into the terrain. If your
mind is set on mining, then
be sure to gather some Coal.
It's an excellent energy
source.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
The Trap Lurking in the Rock
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Basarios eats ore to
grow, so its outer shell
can often contain the stuff.
Destroy its body parts and
you may save yourself the
trouble of having to mine.
Two stones, one bird!

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Infernal Overlord
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Owing to a diet heavy in
ore and coal, the Gravios
boasts an incredibly hard
outer shell that takes
seriously robust weapons to
penetrate. If you're not
having any luck, you can
always try sneaking some
Powderstones instead...

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
A Subspecies Clad in Black
text.description:
A Black Gravios, stained by
volcanic smoke and ash, has
appeared. One look at it
will make your blood curdle.
Still, if it's just a wyvern
encased in armor, surely
you just need to smash that
armor...

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Four Scythes
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its strange limbs to scale
walls right to the ceiling.
If you have trouble hunting
it, you should focus on
picking off the Remobra
flying near the craters
instead.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
The Shogun of Sky and Earth
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its curious limbs to climb
to great heights. This is
also the season when you'll
find large numbers of young
Ceanataurs in the Volcano.
Beware of their sharp claws.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
The Golden Mane
text.description:
A frightful monster has been
sighted at the edge of the
scorched land. Its power is
said to be comparable only
to that of an elder dragon,
and its body gives off a
radiant golden glow. No
hunter has yet seen it and
lived to tell the tale...

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
The King's Domain
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Verdant Hills are ruled
by a certain flying wyvern.
The one and only King of the
Skies, a paragon of might --
the Rathalos. Anyone able to
hunt it will be acclaimed as 
a true first-rate hunter.

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
The Azure Dragon's Roar
text.description:
We've confirmed reports of
an Azure Rathalos in the
Verdant Hills. Only a hunter
with the might of a dragon
could hope to stand up to
its ferocious force. We'd
love to see someone like
that in action...

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
The King of the Skies
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Verdant Hills are ruled
by a certain flying wyvern.
The one and only King of the
Skies, a paragon of might --
the Rathalos. Any who return
bearing eggs plucked from
its nest shall forever be
celebrated for their valor.

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
The Wyverns' Den
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
A pair of kings has been
spotted soaring over the
remote Ancient Tower. It
can only be accessed when
the climate is just right.
In other words, now is the
time!

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Thunderous Might
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Lightning strikes of an
unprecedented scale have
been witnessed near the
Ancient Tower. We'd like
to call on only the most
elite hunters to go out
and investigate.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Mighty Tempest
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
We've received reports of
a violent sandstorm in the
Desert. We'd like to call
on only the most skilled
hunters to investigate
and eliminate its source.
Be advised, we are unable
to provide any supplies.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Mighty Blaze
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
We've received reports of
a raging wildfire in the
Marshlands. It is thought
to be the work of an Elder
Dragon. We'd like you to
investigate immediately.
We cannot provide any
supplies, but we hope for
your safe return.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Karmic Mist
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
One of our best hunters
was brought back severely
wounded after a nightly
expedition to the swamp.
We've received no reports
of any dangerous monsters,
and yet... You've got to
head to the Marshlands and
figure out the cause!

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
The Proud Empress
text.description:
A disaster has struck!
The Empress herself has
returned... This is an
extremely urgent matter.
We cannot send more than
one person to the Tower.
Is there any brave soul
up to the task?

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
The Proud Empress (Repel)
text.description:
We'd like you to deal with
the Lunastra. Ideally you
should slay it, but if that
proves too difficult, you
may repel it. Keep in mind
however, that depending on
your performance we may or
may not reward you with a
slaying certificate.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Mighty Assault
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0
text.description:
The Fortress is under attack
by a Lao Shan-Lung! Use the
weapons around the fort to
repel it! If that proves too
difficult, at least try to
harvest the medicinal stones
from its back!

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
The Floating Mountain
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
A Yama Tsukami has arrived.
And it's said to be covered
by a red aura, too... We'd
like to send you to the
Ancient Tower to investigate
this abnormality. Note that
you may only stay for half
the usual time.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Mighty Advance
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0
text.description:
A mysterious monster is
approaching the Fortress
at a tremendous pace! Use
the weapons around the fort
to repel it! If that proves
too difficult, at least try
to wound its legs!

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Thunderous Arrival
text.description:
We've discovered a powerful
Belkuros in the Canyon. Due
to the dangerous nature of
this request, we cannot
provide any supplies. That
being said, successfully
completing the Quest will
reward you with numerous
rare materials. Good luck!

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
The Stormcaller's Den
text.description:
Up until now, the Belkuros
was thought to live only in
the Canyon. And yet now an
extremely powerful specimen
has been spotted around the
Ancient Tower. The area is
extremely dangerous, and we
cannot provide any supplies.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Mighty Craving
text.description:
Reports of an especially
old Pariapuria have come up.
Rumor has it that it's been
alive for many, many years.
Who knows just how much it
has eaten during then?
You won't need any supplies
...right?

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Mighty Dash
text.description:
We've received reports of a
pair of powerful Orugarons
wreaking havoc in the swamp.
We'll provide a special set
of supplies to aid you in
the hunt. Please, head to
the Marshlands and save the
day!

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Bitterly Cold Showdown
text.description:
Have you ever heard of the
secret part of the Ancient
Tower? Well, an extremely
powerful Duragaua has been
spotted there. Our lack of
knowledge about it makes
this a particularly scary
request. Only hunters who
have proven themselves may
take on this assignment.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Shivering Stalker
text.description:
The Duragaua has migrated.
Up until now, it had only
been spotted at the Tower
and Highlands, but now it
has turned the Canyon into
its new home, making it a
highly adaptable monster.
This specimen is reported
to be extremely powerful.
Steel yourself, hunters.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Draguros Whiplash
text.description:
A flying wyvern known as the
Draguros has been spotted in
the Arctic Ridge.
It is reported to be one of
the strongest of its kind.
Only the most elite hunters
may take on this Quest.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Fallen Angel
text.description:
The Draguros, previously
discovered in the Ridge,
has now been sighted atop
the Highlands. What's worse,
it is thought to be one of
the strongest of its kind.
Only the most elite hunters
may take on this Quest.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Barbaric Beatdown
text.description:
We've received reports
of a Grenzebul thought
to be the strongest of
its kind. This Quest is
extremely dangerous, so
only the most esteemed
hunters may initiate it.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Operation Magnetbreaker
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0
text.description:
A powerful Rukodiora is en
route to Mezeporta Square.
The Interception Base is
armed and ready. Now is the
time to show your worth as
a hunter. Make use of the
weapons around the fort to
dispatch the threat.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Polar Polka
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
We've spotted a Rukodiora
in the Desert. Unlike the
Interception Base, there
are no tools to counter it.
We are looking for elite
hunters to neutralize the
threat. Remember that the
Desert heat is unrelenting,
even during Winter!

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
The Castle from the Sands
text.description:
Countless hunters have been
wounded trying to learn more
about the Odibataurus. It's
still one big mystery, but
we hope you can carry on the
investigation. Watch out for
its deadly sand attacks!

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
The Leaping Scarlet Beast
text.description:
The elusive Gogomoa has been
spotted at the Tidal Island.
What's more, it is reported
to be an extremely powerful
individual. We still have
much to learn about it, so
watch yourself out there.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
A Shadow Bathed in Twilight
text.description:
We've spotted an extremely
powerful Gogomoa. Not only
that, there have also been
numerous reports about a
surge in insect activity
in the area. This won't be
an easy hunt. Be careful.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Lord of the Abyss
text.description:
We've received an emergency
message from the researchers
stationed near the Tidal
Island. Their reports speak
of an extremely powerful
Taikun Zamuza lurking in the
caves below. Please, save
them before it's too late!

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Misty Investigation
text.description:
Word has reached me about a
powerful elder dragon headed
for the Marshlands. Can you
break its parts and hunt it
for me? What about a reward?
Uh, let's see... I think I
still have some materials
left over from my research
into Elder Dragon Wings...

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Menace of the Marshlands
text.description:
An abnormally aggressive
Abiorg has been spotted
in the Marshlands. This
recently discovered monster
is extremely dangerous, so
only the most elite hunters
may take on this Quest.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Arctic Aggressor
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
An abnormally aggressive
Abiorg has been spotted
in the Arctic Ridge.
This Quest is extremely
dangerous and can only
be accepted by approved
hunters. Take all the
necessary precautions.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
The Disastrous Duo
text.description:
The ferocious Abiorg has
been spotted in the Great
Forest. Witness reports
state that several roars
could be heard in the area.
It's almost like it was
communicating... There may
be more than one of them
present. Stay cautious.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
The Brute Dyed in Crimson
text.description:
According to a new report,
the fearsome Abiorg has been
spotted in the Jungle. One
of the witnesses reported
seeing numerous tracks and
hearing roars from multiple
directions. There may be
more than one in the area.
Exercise caution.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Through Storm and Fury
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
The recently discovered
monster has been confirmed
to be a leviathan, known
as the Quarzeps. It seems
to be one of the strongest
of its kind. The Guild is
worried about the research
team's safety. Head to the
locale and secure the area.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
A Shine Piercing the Storm
text.description:
We have received reports of
a powerful Quarzeps atop the
Great Forest. Its ability to
absorb and reflect lightning
make it a highly dangerous
opponent. Steel yourselves,
hunters.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
The Dazzling Duo
text.description:
A pair of Quarzeps has been
spotted in the Desert. One
of the researchers claims to
have felt violent tremors in
from the ground. The details
are unknown, but there is no
time to make any inquiries.
Head out and investigate.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Desert Barrage
text.description:
A mysterious, scarlet-hued
monster has appeared in the
Desert. Reports speak of its
colossal size and tremendous
strength. We're dealing with
an unknown threat here, so
go out and investigate!

text.title:
≪Test of Might≫
Test of Might: Plesioth
text.success_cond:
Slay the target monster, or
complete Subquest A or B
text.description:
We've prepared a special
Quest for those wanting
to obtain Mighty Tickets.
While not particularly
difficult, there is one
catch: You must use an
SP Weapon. Ready? Then
go out and hunt!

in the area. Grab a partner
if you need to, head out,

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Gendrome Attack!
text.description:
It looks like an especially
powerful Gendrome is going
out of its way to terrorize
hunters. It may prove to be
a formidable foe, but the
rewards will more than make
up for it.

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Cephadrome Attack!
text.description:
A powerful Cephadrome has
appeared. Any hunters who
can take it down will be
rewarded with a hefty sum.
However, please be advised
that other rewards will be
limited.

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Velocidrome Attack!
text.description:
A powerful Velocidrome has
appeared. Any hunters who
can take it down will be
rewarded with a hefty sum.
However, please be advised
that other rewards will be
limited.

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Gypceros Attack!
text.description:
We've received an unusual
report about a pair of
Gypceros rampaging through
the Jungle. The Guild is
urgently looking for able-
bodied hunters ready to
neutralize the threat!

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Bulldrome Attack!
text.description:
Welcome to the Arena! This
time you'll be up against
the bane of all villages,
the infamous Bulldrome!
But that's not all! A herd
of Bullfango has also been
unleashed into the Arena!
Will you stand against
their tusked fury, or die
trying!?

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Hypnocatrice Attack!
text.description:
Welcome to the Arena! This
time you'll be up against a
pair of Hypnocatrice! Can
YOU weave your way through
their sleep-inducing gas
and deliver the finishing
blow? Gold and glory awaits
you! Step right up!

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Fanged Beast Attack!
text.description:
Welcome to the Arena!
Representing the fanged
beasts: Blangonga and
Congalala! The two are
deadly enough on their own,
but paired together!? Is
anyone capable of taking
down these beasts!? Even
one slip up could cost
your life! Step right up!

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Basarios Attack!
text.description:
An especially fierce pair
of monsters -- a Basarios,
together with a Gravios,
has shown up. The Guild is
urgently looking for able-
bodied hunters ready to
neutralize the threat!

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Diablos Attack!
text.description:
Welcome to the Arena! This
time, following a request
from the Elder Hall, we've
unleashed an exceptionally
powerful Diablos into the
Arena! Who among you shall
slay this mighty beast and
break the bank!? Step right
up!

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Rathalos Attack!
text.description:
Welcome to the Arena! This
time you're up against a
pair of Rathalos! Who will
live to tell the tale of
this fiery feud!? The King
of the Skies? Or the King of
the Hunt? Step right up!

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Plesioth Attack!
text.description:
I've received reports of
a giant Plesioth in the
Desert. A beast this size
simply must be fished out,
so make sure to do that
before anything. You will
be handsomely rewarded.
What's that? Don't feel
like fishing? No way!
That won't fly.

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Gravios Attack!
text.description:
It seems the swamp has been
taken over by two Gravios,
brought by the desire for
ore. Are there any hunters
brave enough to face such
formidable foes?

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Rajang Attack!
text.description:
This time you're up against
a... I mean -- THE Rajang!
And two of them at that!
Who among you shall slay
these Golden Beasts and
break the bank!? Step right
up!

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Aberrant Lavasioth Attack!
text.success_cond:
Slay the target monster, and
damage the specified parts
text.description:
An exceptionally powerful
Lavasioth has been spotted
at the Volcano. It is known
by some as the "Lord of the
Volcano". Such a towering
figure... How could anyone
hope to defy it!? Oh... if
only there was a legendary
hunter, capable of ending
its reign...

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Aberrant Rajang Attack!
text.description:
This time you're up against
a pair of shadows. In the
red corner: The Dark Wolf
-- Yian Garuga! And in the
blue corner -- The Golden
Lion, Rajang! Who among you
shall slay the two Aberrant
savages and claim the
bounty!?

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Grenzebul Assault!
text.description:
You there, youngster. How
about a little hunt? Your
target will be slightly
larger, and maybe a little
stronger than usual. What's
the reward? Not much, but it
should be a good learning
experience.

≪Special Quest≫
Black Diablos Assault!
text.description:
Your target this time is a
fearsome Black Diablos. It
won't be easy, but if you
prevail, you'll receive a
hefty sum of Zenny and a
good deal of HRP!

text.title:
≪Special Quest≫
Lavasioth Assault!
text.description:
Your target this time is a
fearsome Lavasioth. It won't
be easy, but if you prevail,
you'll receive a hefty sum
of Zenny and a good deal of
HRP!

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Twin Fire Lances
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
We've spotted the Silver and
Azure Rathalos at the Tower.
They looked ordinary, but
their power was out of this
world! If one were to hunt
them, they could get their
hands on a material said to
be infused with their very
soul...

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Cruel Couple
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
A pair of ferocious Diablos
is rampaging through the
Desert! Not only are they
stronger, but their horns
seem to be even more brutal
than usual. It certainly
won't be easy, but if one
were to get their hands on
them... In any case, please
deal with them!

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
URGENT: Sweepers Needed!
text.description:
近ごろ、雪山に猪が大量に
発生していてケガ人が続出し
ています。ハンターズギルド
は、この≪ドスファンゴ≫を
中心とした群れを退治してく
ださる方々を募集しておりま
す。事態は深刻のため、
報酬も一部のハンターが垂涎
する貴重な素材になります。

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Dark Wooden Bow
text.description:
失われた名弓「黒弓」を知っ
ているか？その素材を持って
いるが、タダではやらないよ。
火山に棲みつく黒鎧竜を弓で
狩猟してくれれば、キミの実
力を認めて、この≪墨のカケ
ラ≫を差し上げよう。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
The Angler's Path: Upgrade
text.description:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う
孤独な狩り。
以前に渡した設計図を工房の
親方に手渡してハンマーを
作ったと思うが、実はさらに
強化することができるのじゃ！
改良したければ、白銀の秘壺
３３個を持ってくるがよい。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
The Master Miner's Challenge
text.description:
ほう、ワシの依頼を
受けてくれるというのか。
採掘名人への道は険しいぞ？
それでは、貴重な鉱石２種を
大量に集めてもらおうかの。
そうすれば交換で、秘蔵の
鉱石をくれてやろう。
秘蔵の鉱石を集めれば
集めるほど、オヌシは
採掘名人に近づくじゃろう。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Ancient Dragonbone Bow
text.description:
発掘で石を発見したんじゃが、
これでは価値が見出せん！
そこでハンターであるお主に
ゆびきり草を集めて欲しい。
ゆびきり草を束にすることで、
石を磨くことができるんじゃ。
持ってきてくれれば、
余った石をわけてやるぞい。

text.title:
≪Note Quest≫
Boron: Blue Yian Kut-Ku
text.description:
Ancient notes about crafting
techniques, believed to have
been lost to time, have been
found on monsters in various
locales! If you happen to
get your hands on one, bring
it to me at once! I'll show
you what a real man can do!

techniques, believed to have
been lost to time, have been
found on monsters in various
locales! If you happen to
get your hands on one, bring
it to me at once! I'll show
you what a real man can do!

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Bird-brained Beatdown
text.description:
Aim for the head, strike,
strike, and strike again!
Those are the fundamentals
of hunting. If you want to
get your hands on this rare
bone, take my beloved gear
and bash some birds in!

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Arctic Ridge Lost & Found
text.description:
One of the veteran hunters
was descending the Arctic
Ridge, when he was attacked
by a dangerous monster. He
dropped everything and made
a run for it. I was asked to
recover his stuff, but...
Look, help me out and I'll
share some of it with you.
Do we have a deal?

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Mystery of the Lost Ruins
text.description:
I've heard this rumor about
ancient ruins hidden in the
Marshlands. I went to go and
check them out myself, but
an Aqra Jebia stood in my
way. Think y'could get rid
of it for me? I'll give ya'
a part of the artifacts I
find as thanks.

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Flaming Thornsword
text.description:
So, I've spotted a Flaming
Espinas at the Tower. It
looked pretty ordinary, but
I sensed something special
from its horns, spikes, and
certain scales... Reckon if
ya' hunt it down, we might
be able to get our hands on
some unique materials...

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Pearl Thornsword
text.description:
So, I've spotted a Pearl
Espinas at the top of the
Great Forest. It looked
ordinary, but I sensed
something special from its
horns, spikes, and certain
scales... Reckon if ya' hunt
it down, we might be able to
get our hands on some unique
materials...

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Ultimate Thornsword
text.success_cond:
Slay the target monster, and
damage the specified part
text.description:
The sword you've forged
is far from reaching its
true potential. Complete
this Quest to get your
hands on the "Stout Thorn"
and awaken its latent
power.

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Argenite Sword & Shield
text.description:
Looking for a one-handed
Sword? I've got you! Ever
heard of Argenite? Just one
thing... The ore used to
make it is incredibly rare,
and its usually surrounded
by some nasty monsters.
Do your best and I'll take
it from there!

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Black Bastion
text.description:
A pair of old Black Gravios
has appeared in the swamp.
Considering their age and
huge bodies... They could
probably devour all the ore
in the area! Is there any
brave soul ready to take
them out?

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
The Secret of the Raths
text.description:
I have studied the Raths for
many years, and my research
is all but complete. Now all
that's left for me to do, is
to study the Aberrant ones!
With that my book will be
ready! I need you to capture
both of them for me. If you
do, I'll gift you a copy.

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Sandy Surprise
text.success_cond:
Hunt one of the target
monsters
text.description:
You want my flute? Hmm...
I can't just give it away
for some trinkets... See,
there's some folks out in
the Desert that have real
beef with that flute. The
scar on my face, too. Tell
you what: If you manage to
hunt them down, I might
just give it away.

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
A Battle on Two Fronts
text.description:
I've been working on telling
the tale of a most wonderful
melody I'd heard in a far
away land, but recently I
have inherited a mysterious
stone. I don't think I'm
worthy of it, however...
If you complete the Quest,
I'll award you with both the
stone and the melody.

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
The Rookie Carver's Trial
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster and
damage the specified part
text.description:
My master says that a REAL
carver SHOULD be able to
carve a Gravios's tailbone
with his eyes closed... And
now he wants me to show him
one. Can you capture and
sever an Aberrant Gravios's
tail? I'll carve the bone,
show it to my master, and
then give it to you.

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Lava Dancers
text.description:
The sight of living beings
fighting for their lives...
What a thrill! How about
this -- Head to the Volcano
and hunt down a Shogun
Ceanataur. I shall reward
you with a precious, jeweled
egg. They say that there's a
fanged beast in the area,
but you can leave it be...

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Wild Dark Dancers
text.description:
I came to visit the Canyon,
hoping to admire its many
breathtaking views, but all
I saw was a bunch of brutal
monsters. I believe they are
known around here as the
Yian Garuga and Rajang?
I had no choice but to come
back... Please get rid of
these menaces!

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
The Red Guard
text.description:
A certain traveler really
wants to visit the Jungle.
According to their servant,
the place is swarming with
Daimyo Hermitaur, and they
want them gone. Apparently
they're offering a special
reward... Interested?

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Blue with a Hint of Blue
text.description:
Ah, right, that painting the
Guild ordered... Yes, yes,
of course. All that's left
is the Velocipreys. Oh, if
only anyone was willing to
help me capture their raw
ferocity... I'm sure the
Guild would reward them
handsomely...

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫

text.description:
Ah, right, that painting the

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
The Hymn of the Hills
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A
text.description:
Once upon a time, in a land
far, far away, I'd heard a
most wonderful melody. I've
been a performer for a very
long time, but that melody
stirred my very soul. If
you manage to complete the
Quest with what I provide,
I will award you with its
second part...

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Honest Hammering
text.success_cond:
Hunt one of the target
monsters
text.description:
What, you want this piece
of junk? It says something
about upgrading armor. I
could do it, but not for a
wimp like you... How bout'
ya get some more experience
first. Forging's all about
fire, a bit of clink, and a
whole lotta clang. Got it?

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Proof of Patience
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A or B
text.description:
Stunning medallion, right?
If you work hard, you too
can make something like it.
Patience is a virtue for
artisans and hunters alike.
If you can show me just how
patient you really are, it's
all yours.

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Pink & Poisonous Peril
text.description:
An Aberrant Gypceros and
Congalala seem to be causing
quite the ruckus around the
Jungle. Please hunt them as
soon as possible. You will
be rewarded with a special
emblem provided to us by
the Guild.

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Verdant Hills Reprisal
text.description:
I was out gathering in the
Verdant Hills, when a pair
of Rathalos attacked! I've
saved my skin, but I can't
just stand by and let them
wreak havoc. Can you handle
it? I'll give ya' a Sturdy
Jawbone in return.

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Dark Wolf, Dark Stars
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A or B
text.description:
I saw it! A bona fide meteor
shower! You may be able to
find traces of them around
the Jungle. I hear there's
a Garuga in the area though,
so be careful!

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Desert Crown
text.success_cond:
Slay the Aqra Vashim and
hunt the Gendrome
text.description:
I was ambushed by a color-
shifting scorpion! What's
worse, I dropped my precious
book... If you've got the
time, could you please look
for it? Still, the crystals
on that critter were one-of-
a-kind. I'd love to add some
to my costume...

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Feathered Flurry
text.description:
樹海で珍しい蒼色の眠鳥たち
が発見されたそうじゃな。
あいつらは昼の間、泣き叫ん
でうるさくてかなわん。
そこで相談じゃが、あいつを
討伐してきてくれんか？
お礼は「青色の羽毛」じゃ。
クチバシも壊してくれると、
さらにスカッとするのう。

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
All Fired Up!
text.description:
Hey, you love the Gunlance
don't you? I'll tell 'ya
something good. Now, don't
be shy! A Silver Rathalos's
been spotted at the Tower.
And my hunch tells me it'd
make an awesome Gunlance!
Go out there and blast away!
Show the King how it's done!

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Ancient Dark Bow
text.description:
In order to bring out the
great Dark Bow's power, it
must be treated with Ancient
Ink, which I just so happen
to have. I will not do it
for free, however. Prove
your worth by hunting an
Akantor with the Bow, and
I'll gladly help you.

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Nature's Chorus: Desert
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monsters,
or deliver the items
text.description:
I can hear it. The ocean's
roar, the wind's howl, the
forest's hush. But can you?
Complete this Quest to get
your hands on materials used
to craft the following sets
of armor: Khezu RX, Diablos
LX and Cephalos RX. I hope
your hunting career will be
long and fruitful.

Complete this Quest to get

Ceanataur RX. I hope your
hunting career will be long
and fruitful.

text.title:
≪Special Material Quest≫
Insult to Injury
text.description:
I think the Arctic Ridge may
have finally broken me. I've
been a hunter for many, many
years, but I've never felt
this horrified. I thought I
wouldn't make it. I remember
seeing a strange black metal
on my way back, but I had no
chance to look into it.

≪Decoration Quest≫
Fasting, Focus, Trapmaster
text.success_cond:
Slay the target monster, or
complete Subquest A
text.description:
I've found some priceless
decorations while looking
through a Guild warehouse.
There are several different
types, and they can all be
yours if you complete the
Quest! Break the monster's
part to earn a few extra
rewards!

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
The Angler's Path: Small Fry
text.description:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。モンスター
を狩るだけがハンターじゃな
い。釣りだって立派な狩猟だ。
君も釣師を目指してみないか？
もし目指すなら、一人でカジ
キマグロ１０匹の納品からだ。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
The Angler's Path: Rookie
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Plesioth is hunted
text.description:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。次は日々の
研鑽の積み重ねを証明して貰
おう。一人でガノトトスの一
本釣りと魚拓【小】１０枚の
納品だ。ガノトトスは絶対に
狩らずに釣り上げるんだぞ。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
The Angler's Path: Reel Pro
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Green Plesioth is hunted
text.description:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。報酬は、
釣師の証になる、ある素材だ。
今までの集大成を見せてくれ！
釣りが目的だから、ガノトト
ス亜種は今回も絶対に狩らな
いように！

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
The Angler's Path: Legend
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Plesioth is hunted
text.description:
釣り、それは魚と静かに向き
合う孤独な狩り。
その腕前はもはや名人の域に
達しているじゃろ。
そこで、ワシから一子相伝の
技を授けてやろうかの。
条件は、魚拓【大】の納品と
ガノトトス変種の一本釣り
じゃ。待ってるぞ！

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Harvest Mining - Part 1
text.description:
You've come a long way,
haven't you? Hunting is
great, but mining is fun
too! How about you give
it a shot? I want you to
collect a lot of specific
ores. You'll get yourself
a special reward if you do.

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Harvest Mining - Part 2
text.description:
Mining is great. It helps
me relax. I always bring a
pickaxe when I go hunting!
For my next request, I want
you to deliver more quality
ore. Expect to be rewarded!

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Harvest Gathering - Part 1
text.description:
Good day, nice to meet you.
Have you been gathering out
on a hunt? I think it's high
time you showed us how far
you've come. Naturally, you
will be handsomely rewarded.

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Harvest Gathering - Part 2
text.description:
Back at it gathering today?
Instead of worrying about
tools, you want to focus on
getting new armor, right?
Well, I've got another favor
to ask. It might be a bit
harder than last time, but
please do your best. It'll
be worth it.

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Harvest Mining - Finale
text.description:
Time for my final request.
"Are you going to ask me to
go mining again?" -- No, all
I want you to do is exchange
the coins you've obtained so
far. By the way, I've never
had Khezu Ice Cream... Think
you could help with that?

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Harvest Gathering - Finale
text.description:
Time for my final request.
Although...giving you the
final coin just like that
would be anticlimactic...
I want you to fetch me a
Carnivore Egg. They're too
heavy for me to carry them
myself.

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Bearer of Good Fortune (Blade)
text.description:
Hey, it's you! Thanks for
getting me that salt the
other day! ...Just kidding.
It's YOU! You're the Master
Gatherer! It must be fate
for us to meet again like
this. Bring me the coins
again, and I'll give you
a new set!

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Bearer of Good Fortune (Gun)
text.description:
Hey, it's you! Thanks for
getting me that salt the
other day! ...Just kidding.
It's YOU! You're the Master
Gatherer! It must be fate
for us to meet again like
this. Bring me the coins
again, and I'll give you
a new set!

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Avatar of Prosperity: Blade
text.description:
It began as a small seed,
but through devoted care,
it grew into a bountiful
harvest -- and in time, it
brought true abundance.
Yet this is far from over.
Hear me, Mystic Tome owners!
For even greater prosperity
awaits you!

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Avatar of Prosperity: Gunner
text.description:
It began as a small seed,
but through devoted care,
it grew into a bountiful
harvest -- and in time, it
brought true abundance.
Yet this is far from over.
Hear me, Mystic Tome owners!
For even greater prosperity
awaits you!

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
And Thus, The Harvest Begins
text.description:
You've completed the two
master's requests! Your
reward will be a set of
coins used to craft a
certain piece of armor.
Oh yeah, I'm all out of
rock salt, could you go
get me some while you're
at it?

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Shell King: Seaside
text.description:
ひとつ、狩りをお願いする。
俺は大好きなんだ。
狩りは狩りでも潮干狩り！
将来は貝に埋もれて過ごすの
が夢なんだ。貝をいっぱいあ
つめてきてくれないか？
もちろん、報酬も弾むぜ？

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Shell King: Seafolk
text.description:
だいぶ集まってきた貝？
……なんてね。
貝の中に稀に入っている石。
これも必要なんだ。
大変だと思うが、もう少し
潮干狩りをお願いするよ。
報酬？
大丈夫。覚えているよ。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Shell King: Finale
text.description:
だいぶ集まってきたようだ。
俺の夢までもう一歩。
もう少し。
あともう少しだけ付き合って
欲しい。
もちろん、達成できた暁には
素晴らしいお宝をあげるよ。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Way of the Bugcatcher I
text.description:
この世界には様々な虫たちが
いるよね。
その中でも、私は≪キラビー
トル≫が好きでたくさん集め
てるの。
あなたも手伝ってくれるなら、
５０匹ごとに私のところに
持ってきて。
そしたら≪斬硬玉≫を１つあ
げるよ。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Way of the Bugcatcher II
text.description:
虫取り名人への道って何だろ。
間違っても道を歩くことじゃ
ないと思うの。
そんなことより、まだまだ
≪キラビートル≫を集めてい
るから持ってきてほしい。
何に使うかは秘密よ。
５０匹ほど納品したら、
≪極焔珠≫を３つあげるわ。

text.title:
≪長期イベントクエスト≫
沈黙の大剣・冠婚の章
text.description:
「冠婚つらら」をご存じか？
男女が結ばれて子供が生まれ、
世代が一巡するほどの長い
時間をかけてできあがった、
ロマンあふれるつららなんだ。
知る者の少ない貴重品だが、
俺の依頼をこなしてくれたら、
少しくらいは分けてやれるぞ。

text.title:
≪長期イベントクエスト≫
沈黙の大剣・千年の章
text.description:
見なれた密林であっても、
俺のようなプロにかかれば、
希少素材を見つけ出すことが
可能なのさ。あの辺に徘徊
する邪魔なモンスターさえ
片付けてくれれば、希少素材
「千年雪」を見つけてやるぜ。

text.title:
≪長期イベントクエスト≫
沈黙の大剣・永久の章
text.description:
塔は実に謎の多い場所だな。
だが、極寒の地で育った俺の
直感が、ここに眠る希少素材
の存在を告げているんだ……。
ハンターさんにはいつも通り
邪魔なモンスターの狩猟を
お願いしたい。俺はその間に
素材探しをさせてもらおう！

text.title:
≪長期イベントクエスト≫
沈黙の大剣・成就の章
text.success_cond:
Hunt one of the target
monsters
text.description:
知っての通り、俺は探検家だ。
どんな苦労も恐れはしない。
そしてハンターさんよ、同じ
匂いをあんたからも感じるぜ。
高難度の仕事が、大願成就の
ための氷山の一角でしかない
とわかっていても、それでも
情熱を失わずに歩み続ける！
お互いやっかいな性分だな！

text.title:
≪長期イベントクエスト≫
破天の銃槍・盤石の章
text.description:
どんなものにも、本当の姿と
偽りの姿があります。まずは、
私からの依頼をこなすことで、
本物を見抜く目を鍛えなさい。
上手くいったら、私が集めた
奇妙な石を差し上げましょう。
特殊構造のガンランスを生産
することができるはずですよ。

text.title:
≪長期イベントクエスト≫
破天の銃槍・道草の章
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A.
text.description:
目標に向かって進むことは
大切ですが、時には脇道に
それることも必要なのです。
「ネコかぶり」は道草を食う
ことでしか手に入れることが
できない特殊な植物です。
あなたのペースでじっくりと
集めるのがよいでしょう。

text.title:
≪長期イベントクエスト≫
破天の銃槍・豹変の章
text.description:
嘘をつくことは悪でしょうか。
時には、善意の嘘が人を救う
場合もあります。必要以上に
偽りを恐れてはなりません。
モンスターの狩猟を通して、
あなた自身が変わっていく
ことを願っております。

text.title:
≪長期イベントクエスト≫
破天の銃槍・止揚の章
text.description:
白い紙に白い文字を書いても
読むことができませんよね。
黒い紙に黒い文字を書いても
同じことです。白と黒とが
組み合わさることで、初めて
新たな価値が生まれるのです。
相反するもの、その両方を
認めることで更なる価値を
生むこと、それが止揚です。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Explosive Ore: Part 1
text.description:
よぉ。久しぶりだな。
今日も楽しく採掘してるか？
また、採掘の良さを知っても
らう為に、依頼を用意したぞ。
さびた塊など５種類の中から
３つを集めてもらうぜ。
報酬はちゃんと用意してある
から安心して行ってこい！

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Explosive Ore: Part 2
text.description:
さて【後編】だ。
さびた塊などの５種類から、
【前編】とは違う２種類を納
品してもらうぞ。
報酬は、調合屋のあるじが
ある実験をしたい為に喉から
手が出るほど欲しがってる一
品だ。これで何をするのかは
知らんがな。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Explosive Ore: Finale
text.description:
採掘師が依頼した素材を見事
に集めきったようですね。
調合屋のあるじから聞いた話
によると、大量の琥珀の稀水、
翡翠の稀水に火薬岩を調合す
ると、爆発したように燃える
希少な鉱石ができるらしいの。
あなたも試してみない？

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Explosive Ore: Epilogue
text.description:
前の依頼で終わりなんだけど、
少し続きがあったみたい。
昔、超高温の石を発見した
のだけれど、この鉱石を運ぶ
ことができなかったの。
でも、あの水で冷却すると、
運べることが分かったわ。
だから、もう一度だけ大量に
納品してくれないかしら？

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Insect Prison
text.description:
モンスターの自由を奪う快感、
それは何物にも代えがたいわ。
私の≪濃縮クビキエキス≫を
使えば、あなたもその快感を
存分に味わうことができるの。
ただし、私が同類と認めた人
にしか渡さないのよ。小さな
束縛の繰り返しに楽しみを
見出せること。それが条件。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Insects of Fate
text.description:
モンスターの自由を奪う快感、
存分に味わっているかしら？
もしも、高みへ至った自信が
あるのなら、次のステップを
教えてあげてもいいのよ…。
爆発力を抑制する代わりに、
神をも縛ると言い伝えられる
≪テュライト純晶石≫…。
ちょっと試してみたくない？

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Mysterious Flowers 1
text.description:
わたしはねー花売りなのー。
でも、普段は広場にいません。
どこで売ってるか秘密なのー。
あ、そうだ。ハンターさんに
お願いがあるんだ―。
高地にあるイワヒメ草をたく
さん採ってきてほしいのー。
わたしにくれたら、遠くから
飛んできた種を１つあげるー。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Mysterious Flowers 2
text.description:
やっほー。花売りだよー。
ハンターさんからもらった
イワヒメ草を高地に植えたら
たくさんの花が咲いたよー。
やったね！
そういえば、高地で不思議な
水が湧く場所を見つけたんだ。
この水をわたしがあげた種と
交換してあげるよー。

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Mushroom Mania 1
text.description:
君もキノコマニアになりた
いって？
この道は君が考えているほど
簡単な道のりでは無いのだよ。
まずはコウザンダケを大量に
集めてくるんだ！
話はそれからだ！

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
Mushroom Mania 2
text.description:
よくここまで頑張ったね。
君のキノコ道はあと少しだ！
今まで集めた紫苑の稀袋を全
て私のところへ持ってくるん
だ！キノコマニアとしての証
を君に進呈しよう！

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
A Bouquet for your Love
text.description:
こんにちは。僕は愛と奇跡の
花束マイスターさ。ふむふむ、
ハートをズドンと射止めたい、
気になる相手がいるのかい？
それなら、僕に任せてよ！
指定の植物を集めてくれたら、
素敵な花束を作ってあげる。
君と出会えたこの運命を祝し、
心を込めて取り掛かるよ！

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
The Angler's Path: Artisan
text.description:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
ハンターはモンスターを狩る
だけじゃない。釣りだって立
派な狩猟だ。
釣師への道、しかも職人を
目指してみないか？
もし目指すなら、一人で春夜
鯉５０匹の納品だ！

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
The Angler's Path: Research
text.description:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
次は日々の研鑽の積み重ねを
証明して貰おう。
その研究の証として、白銀の
秘壺１０個を納品してくれ！

text.title:
≪Long-Term Event Quest≫
The Angler's Path: Design
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Plesioth is hunted
text.description:
「釣り」
それは魚と静かに向き合う孤
独な狩り。
貴重な壺を納品してくれれば、
お礼に、私が新しいリールの
設計図を作成して進呈しよう。
もちろん、普通のリールじゃ
ないがね。

text.title:
≪Skill Match Quest≫
Arena Showdown: D.Hermitaur
text.description:
Hear ye, hunters! Who among
you would slay the fearsome
Daimyo? It'll be you, the
monster, and the arena. No
holds barred! You're not in
it for the reward, right?
Think of the glory! Stand
tall with your comrades and
hone your hunting skills!

text.title:
≪Base Defense≫
Operation Magnetchaser
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0
text.description:
An unidentified monster has
been spotted in the skies,
and is headed towards the
Square. Calling all hunters!
Use the weapons around the
base to intercept the target
and eliminate it. We've also
enlisted the aid of Master
Carvers for this operation.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Desert Danse Macabre
text.description:
大変です！現在、砂漠へ
向けて、何かが高速で
飛来しているとの情報です。
目撃者によると、見た目は
飛竜のようだったとの
話ですが…。情報不足
で申し訳ありませんが、
大至急、砂漠へ向かい
討伐してください！

text.title:
≪Base Defense≫
Operation Magnetbane
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0
text.description:
≪ルコディオラ≫≪極龍≫と
名付けられたそれが、
≪迎撃拠点≫に迫っています。
十分な支給品、迎撃兵器、
そして剥ぎ取り職人と、万全
の態勢を整えさせていただき
ましたので、討伐をお願い
します！

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
A Shine in the Sandstorm
text.description:
現在、砂漠に飛来しつつある
モンスターが何であるか
判明しました。
光り輝く翼を持つ古龍種、
≪ルコディオラ≫です。
猛スピードで砂漠に
迫っています。
大至急、砂漠へ向かい
討伐してください！

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Heavenly Thunder
text.description:
Thanks to your efforts, new
paths have opened up in the
Canyon, sending traders over
the moon... Belkuros parts
are said to be all the rage
these days. This has sparked
the interest of the Guild,
causing them to *heavily*
encourage hunting it.

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Rolling with Thunder
text.description:
According to the merchants,
Belkuros parts are growing
more and more popular. The
Guild now provides a special
set of supplies, hoping to
further incentivize hunting
it. The rewards are, as per
usual, rare materials. What
exactly? You'll just have to
hunt and see!

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Frontal Thunderstorm
text.description:
If there's ever been a time
to hunt the Belkuros - it's
right NOW. Rumor has it that
the strongest individuals
have started popping up in
the Canyon. The Guild will
provide a special set of
supplies to aid you on the
hunt. Keep your wits about
you, hunters...

text.title:
≪Akantor Slaying≫
To Victory and Beyond
text.description:
An Akantor is wreaking havoc
on Guild territory! Through
our efforts, we've managed
to pinpoint its location to
be the Battlegrounds. Brave
hunters at the ready! It's
time to end this!

text.title:
≪Akantor Slaying≫
Warring Overlord
text.description:
We've received reports of
Aberrant Monsters showing
up in various locales.
They may look the same, but
their true abilities are
still shrouded in mystery.
Go out and investigate.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Dyegrass Hunters Assemble!
text.description:
≪センショク草≫という
不思議な草がある。
これは各地で採取が可能
で、特殊な装飾品を装着
できる武具の素材となる
のだ。わたしの依頼を
達成してくれたら、少し
君にも分けてあげよう。

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Hardcore Ticket Exchange
text.description:
ここは秘伝書を持つハンター
にのみ入場が許された交換所
だ。公式狩猟大会で優秀な成
績をおさめたことを証明する
証を納品すれば、賞品として
手に入れた武具を更に強化す
るための素材をやろう。生半
可な実力では手に入れること
はできんぞ？

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Egg Run Rewards: Power Gem
text.description:
いつもご苦労さん！
≪ハンターの本・白≫
≪ハンターの本・青≫
≪ハンターの本・赤≫
を全部持ってきてくれたら、
素敵な物と交換してやるよ。
これらを手に入れるには、
アプリで運搬をする必要が
あるみたいだな。
…アプリってなんだ？

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Felyne Force
text.description:
よう、こいつを見てくれよ。
いい武器だろ？これは、対
変種に適した特殊な武器の
一種でな。しかも、装備して
いることが、一部の依頼の
条件にもなっているって話だ。
お前さんも作ってみるかい？
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
余った素材を分けてやるぜ。

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
鋭き鎌を閃かせ
text.description:
よう、お前もようやく凄腕
ハンターに到達したんだな。
ハンターズギルドから特殊な
武器を貰っただろ？あれは対
変種に適した武器で一部の
依頼を受ける条件にもなって
いる。
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
強化用の素材を分けてやるぜ。
やってみないか？

≪Mighty Quest≫
Operation Rustscraper
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires
or Integrity hits 0
text.description:
An extremely powerful Rusted
Kushala Daora is headed for
Mezeporta! Calling all able-
bodied hunters to neutralize
the threat immediately!

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
The Thunderstruck Volcano
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
We've received reports of
lightning strikes in the
volcanic belt. We'd like
to send the most esteemed
hunters to investigate.
Be advised, no supplies
will be provided for this
Quest. Exercise extreme
caution.

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Hungering in the Highlands
text.description:
A Pariapuria has been
spotted in the Highlands!
It has no doubt devoured
numerous things, so its
probably got some fight
in it! Unfortunately, we
cannot provide you with
any supplies, please take
care while hunting!

text.title:
≪Mighty Quest≫
Fanged Invaders
text.description:
A pair of powerful Orgaron
have been spotted at the
Ancient Tower. At the moment
they seem to be staying in
one area, but if they move
out in search of prey, they
will cause extensive damage
to the surrounding area. We
cannot let that happen.

text.title:
≪Training: High Rank≫
Velocidrome Hunt (2P)
text.description:
We've got the perfect Quest
for any rookie hunter! We
have confirmed reports of
a relatively weak monster
in the area. Grab a partner
if you need to, head out,
and hunt the target!

with a special item - the
Red Voucher I. We look
forward to your exploits.
