text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Violent Sandstorm
text.description:
The Kushala Daora is far
removed from any monster
you've hunted this far.
It will likely throw your
own powerlessness into
stark relief. Don't even
try to capture it, focus
on steadily wearing it
down instead.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Raging Metal Mallet
text.description:
よう、こいつを見てくれよ。
いい武器だろ？これは、対
変種に適した特殊な武器の
一種でな。しかも、装備して
いることが、一部の依頼の
条件にもなっているって話だ。
お前さんも作ってみるかい？
俺の紹介する依頼をこなせば、
余った素材を分けてやるぜ。

text.title:
≪Guild Order≫
The Legend Soaring the Skies
text.description:
The crew of our newly-built
vessel has spotted a strange
shadow in the clouds. It may
be one of the elder dragons
mentioned in ancient texts.
In light of your exploits,
we are formally requesting
your assistance. Head for
the skies and investigate.

text.title:
≪Guild Order≫
Polar Padrone
text.description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
We've received reports of a
herd of Pokara in the Polar
Sea. We'd like to ask you to
help us study their ecology.

text.title:
≪Guild Order≫
Forest Fandango
text.description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
We've received reports about
a strange bird wyvern in the
Great Forest. It's said to
emit a piercing shriek and
use thunderbolts to attack.
Please investigate.

text.title:
≪Guild Order≫
Storm of Spikes
text.description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
Our team of surveyors has
discovered a Hyujikiki in
the Highlands. Head out and
investigate ASAP.

text.title:
≪Guild Order≫
Volcanic Beast
text.description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
Our team of surveyors has
discovered a Midogaron at
the Volcano. The monster
is said to bear a striking
resemblance to an Orgaron,
but the details are unknown.
Please investigate ASAP.

text.title:
≪Guild Order≫
Ice-splitting Roar
text.description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
Witness reports speak about
powerful roars, similar to
that of an Abiorg, in the
Polar Sea. The details are
unclear, however. Proceed
with caution.

text.title:
≪Guild Order≫
Sea-Sawing Sovereign
text.description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
We've received reports of
an Anorpatis in the Polar
Sea. The monster is known
to strike from underground
and assault its prey.
Proceed with caution.

text.title:
≪GR1 Polar Sea Survey≫
An Innocent Gaze
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I heard that you can see a
bunch of baby Pokara in the
Polar Sea... They're said to
dance in response to certain
movements. How cute! You can
go gather for a little, but
why not play with them? Just
don't be mean!

text.title:
≪GR1 Polar Sea Survey≫
Northern Lights
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Polar nights are extremely
cold -- just standing still
can drain your Stamina. Make
sure you're well prepared.
By the way, they say that a
beautiful aurora stretches
across the night sky above
these frozen lands. If the
hunt proves too tiring, why
not enjoy the view?

text.title:
≪GR1 Tidal Island Survey≫
Tidal Island Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
We've received reports of
never-before-seen materials
at the Tidal Island. There
seem to be no monsters in
the area, making gathering
relatively safe. The Guild
is looking for hunters ready
to investigate the area.

text.title:
≪GR1 Tidal Island Survey≫
Charmed by the Glow
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Insects are fascinating
creatures, don't you think?
Just looking at them fills
your heart with joy... The
Royal Rhino is particularly
beautiful. I could admire it
all day! But they're so hard
to find... Can you find one
for me?

text.title:
≪GR1 Tidal Island Survey≫
The Blue Pack
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I was out researching the
Tidal Island, when suddenly
I got ambushed by a pack of
Velociprey! I've made a run
for it, but I've lost all my
spoils! I need you to hunt
them down and get back my
goods. If you've got time to
spare, could you mine some
ore for me?

text.title:
≪GR1 Jungle Survey≫
Jungle Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I've recently ventured into
an uncharted region of the
Jungle, and found some very
interesting things. I've got
my hands on tons of items,
some of which have nobody
has ever seen before! The
monsters may be tough, but
the trip is well worth it!

text.title:
≪GR1 Jungle Survey≫
Mushroom Masters
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Mosswine have an incredibly
keen nose for mushrooms --
they can sniff them out with
surprising accuracy. Maybe
there's a way to turn that
into a business? But first,
I need to learn more about
their behavior. Mind helping
me out with that?

text.title:
≪GR1 Jungle Survey≫
Jungle Dust Devils
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
We've received reports of a
group of Hermitaur emerging
from the sands and ravaging
a trade caravan. They then
retreated into an uncharted
part of the Jungle. We can't
allow them to cause any more
damage.

text.title:
≪GR1 Tidal Island Survey≫
Seaside Screams
text.description:
We were staying on the Tidal
Island when suddenly a Yian
Kut-Ku showed up and ravaged
our food! Our getaway is all
but ruined... What's worse,
my lady is about to show up,
too. You've got to deal with
that vexing bird before she
arrives, please.

text.title:
≪GR1 Jungle Survey≫
Avian Tango
text.description:
A researcher surveying the
Jungle has spotted a Yian
Kut-Ku. According to him,
it seemed to differ from
usual individuals, but the
details are unknown. We're
looking for hunters ready
to head out and investigate
at once.

text.title:
≪GR1 Desert Survey≫
Desert Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
The Desert is said to hold
many mysteries. Some claim
that there are whole regions
we haven't explored yet!
And these regions are said
to hold unimaginable riches.
We'd love to see it first-
hand, but desert nights are
harsh and unrelenting. We've
got no choice, but to ask
for help. Anyone up?

text.title:
≪GR1 Desert Survey≫
Medicinal Wonders
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
It was back when I'd gone to
gather ingredients for some
medicine. I'd found what I
was looking for and was just
about to leave, but then...
Cephalos! A boatload of 'em!
They robbed me! I'll pay you
a handsome sum, just get rid
of 'em! My poor herbs...

text.title:
≪GR1 Desert Survey≫
The Great Sunlit Shield
text.description:
A panicked adventurer claims
to have seen a Monoblos head
moving by itself. Obviously,
that's impossible, so it's
safe to assume that he saw
a Daimyo Hermitaur. Could
you look into it anyway?

text.title:
≪GR1 Tidal Island Survey≫
The Daimyo of the Caves
text.description:
There was this HUGE crab in
the caverns below the Tidal
Island. I've heard before
that it was covered in some
mighty tasty shrooms! But
the one I found had none...
Maybe it was a different
species? Could you check?

text.title:
≪GR1 Polar Sea Survey≫
Red-eyed Defender
text.description:
Having once stumbled upon a
Pokaradon, I couldn't help
but think: "Its hide would
make for a great product!"
Say, could I ask you to do
a little hunting for me?

text.title:
≪GR1 Polar Sea Survey≫
Leader of the Icy Herd
text.description:
I love researching monster
ecology and I'm willing to
go to great lengths for it.
That being said, if I die,
I won't be able to research
anything. Think you could
escort me?

text.title:
≪GR2 Marshlands Survey≫
The Pink Plague
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I was out in an uncharted
part of the Marshlands when
suddenly... Congas! A whole
pack! I hightailed it outta
there, but that smell! What
a nightmare! If you happen
to be in the area, give them
a lesson for me, will ya?

text.title:
≪GR2 Marshlands Survey≫
Swampy Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
We are looking for hunters
ready to study the ecosystem
of an unexplored region of
the Marshlands. We ask that
you slay the monsters native
to the area and deliver a
Goldenfish, if possible.

text.title:
≪GR2 Marshlands Survey≫
Ravager of the Swamp
text.description:
One of the few unexplored
parts of the swamp is being
ravaged by a Congalala. Not
only does it devour all the
mushrooms, but also leaves
that horrendous stench...
At this rate the ecosystem
will be all but ruined. We
need to deal with it ASAP.

text.title:
≪GR2 Jungle Survey≫
Stench Drenched Evening
text.description:
A horrible stench has been
wafting around my mistress's
manor. It would seem that a
Congalala has settled down
nearby. I cannot allow my
lady to be disturbed in her
quarters... Could you please
hunt that foul beast down?

text.title:
≪GR2 Marshlands Survey≫
Marshlands Light Show!
text.description:
I was out and about in the
swamp, doing my job, when
suddenly I saw many bright
flashes of light in the
distance. The only monster
responsible I can think of
would be the Gypceros. I do
not want it interfering with
the investigation. Could you
lend me a hand?

text.title:
≪GR2 Jungle Survey≫
The Scourge of the Jungle
text.description:
According to our reports,
the Jungle is being ravaged
by a Gypceros flying at
night. If left unchecked,
the region will turn into
a desolate wasteland. This
needs to be dealt with ASAP.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Great Forest Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I'm so close to finishing
my ultimate dish... I just
need one more ingredient.
And don't think I'll settle
for anything but the best of
the best! I need an egg --
a PRIME Wyvern Egg! There's
a nest somewhere in the
Great Forest. You'll find
them there, I know it!

text.title:
≪GR2 Great Forest Survey≫
Shakalaka of the Forest
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
We were on our way to look
into an unexplored area in
the Great Forest. It all
seemed fine until *they*
showed up again. I've saved
my skin, but what about my
comrades!? You've got to
save them, Hunter. Please!

text.title:
≪GR2 Great Forest Survey≫
Eccentric
text.description:
When I heard about that
flashy monster in the Great
Forest, I was shaken to my
core! That bold look, that
violent thunder! And don't
even get me started on that
one of a kind crest! I'd
love to make it part of my
hair. Think you can help
with that?

text.title:
≪GR2 Great Forest Survey≫
Forest-scorching Bolts
text.description:
The Falnocatrice is best
known for its remarkably
flashy appearance. Its
ecology remains largely
unknown, however. We are
looking for hunters to
aid us in our research.

text.title:
≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫
Volcanic Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I'm all outta Powderstones!
How am I supposed to hammer
away like this? Go grab some
for me, will ya'? It'd be
great if you could slay the
Bullfango in the area too.
As long as they're gone, I
can get the rest of 'em no
problem!

text.title:
≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫
The Poisonous Pack
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I was out exploring the
Volcano when I stumbled
upon an honest to Gog 
treasure trove! I was
raring to go explore,
but the monsters there
proved quite formidable...
Please hunt them down.

text.title:
≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫
The Rumbling Volcano
text.description:
During one of our Volcano
surveys, a researcher has
reportedly hit a sleeping
Basarios, causing it to
rampage. The investigation
cannot proceed as long as
the monster is not taken
care of. That's your job.

text.title:
≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫
Mischievous Rock
text.description:
We've received reports of
a rock suddenly attacking
travelers along a newly
built road. We've yet to
look into it, but it's safe
to assume that a Basarios
hit them. Head out and deal
with the threat before any
more damage is done.

text.title:
≪GR3 Verdant Hills Survey≫
Verdant Hills Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Through my research, I've
learned about an uncharted
part of the Verdant Hills
that's just teeming with
treasure. I'd love to head
there at once, but I need
someone to protect me while
I gather. If we make it out
alive, I'll reward you with
some of my findings!

text.title:
≪GR3 Verdant Hills Survey≫
Creeping in the Dark
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I was out and about in the
Hills, when suddenly -- a
blue shadow pounced at me
out of nowhere! I made a run
for it and somehow made it
back, but... that's no way
to work! I'm at my wits' end
here, Hunter. Please, PLEASE
get rid of them!

text.title:
≪GR3 Verdant Hills Survey≫
The Verdant Throne
text.description:
I hear that a Rathian has
made its nest deep within
an unsurveyed part of the
Verdant Hills. I'm sure
taking a quick peek will
lead me to SOME kind of
discovery...
Would you mind helping me?

text.title:
≪GR3 Great Forest Survey≫
Royal Forest
text.description:
We've received reports of
flying wyverns disrupting
the Great Forest. We need
you to deal with it ASAP.
The area has not yet been
fully surveyed, so please
take all the necessary
precautions.

text.title:
≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫
A Scythe Bathed in Crimson
text.description:
A trade convoy has been
attacked in an uncharted
region of the Volcano. Its
cargo has reportedly been
cut open by a sharp object.
What could have done this?
Please investigate at once.

text.title:
≪GR3 Marshlands Survey≫
Reaper of the Marsh
text.description:
I need help surveying the
Marshlands. Don't worry, no
gathering included. I hear
that the area I'm headed for
is frequented by Ceanataurs.
Going by myself would be
quite dangerous. Could you
help me out here?

text.title:
≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫
Highlands Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Have you heard? They've made
some new discoveries in the
Highlands. It turns out that
certain uncharted regions
are filled to the brim with
rare materials. I could take
you there if you'd like.
Just don't get in my way...

text.title:
≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫
The Hunt for Luxury Fur
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I'm trying to make a coat
that'll keep me warm in the
bitter cold. I need someone
to gather the fur for me
though. And not just any old
fur. I need the best of the
best --  Bulluk fur from an
uncharted land -- or some-
thing like that. Could you
do me a favor?

text.title:
≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫
Stormclad Highlander
text.description:
The Hyujikiki prides itself
on its agility and ferocity.
It is extremely territorial
and attacks everything that
dares intrude on its turf.
We can't do anything about
it without first studying
its ecology more thoroughly.
Please help us investigate.

text.title:
≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫
Storm-forged Thorns
text.description:
I was out exploring, when
suddenly I'd stumbled upon
a sharp needle. I've never
seen anything quite like it
before... Perhaps some kind
of monster left it behind?
Time is of the essence.
Head for the Highlands and
get to the bottom of this.

text.title:
≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫
The Cold-Blooded Pack
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I was out gathering in the
Arctic Ridge, but a pack of
Giaprey attacked me and I've
lost everything! And now?
I'm going to die starving...
Sorry to ask this, but would
mind sharing some of your
Khezu Ice Cream...?

text.title:
≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Arctic Ridge Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
The Ridge may be harsh, but
its peaks are surely blessed
by Mother Nature herself.
I've heard tell that Popo
meat is most nourishing.
Would you be so kind as to
hunt some for me? Ah, and
perhaps gather a few Ice
Crystals as well. They are
great for alchemy, you know.

text.title:
≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫
King of the White Pack
text.description:
Having fully conquered the
uncharted regions of the
Arctic Ridge, the Blangonga
seems to be closing in on
inhabited areas. If left
unchecked, it could cause
major damage. Please deal
with it before that happens.

text.title:
≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Blangonga Know No Bounds
text.description:
Say, would you mind hunting
a Blangonga for some fur?
It might be really tough
and bristly, but it makes
for excellent clothing!
All you have to do is hunt
it, I'll do the carving off
myself. Counting on ya'!

text.title:
≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Thunderstruck in the Ridge!
text.description:
I was having the time of my
life, scaling the peaks of
the Arctic Ridge. There I
was, just about to reach the
summit when suddenly -- ZAP!
A bolt out of the blue! And
the skies were so clear...
I can't go on like this! Can
you look into it?

text.title:
≪GR4 Marshlands Survey≫
The Shadow in the Cave
text.description:
We've received reports of a
Khezu in an uncharted part
of the swamp. For everyone's
sake, please go and hunt it.
The Khezu is known for its
silent, but deadly attacks.
Try not to get caught by
surprise, alright?

text.title:
≪Guild Order≫
The Invoker of Calamity
text.description:
In light of your outstanding
achievements, the Guild has
a special request for you.
We've received reports about
a mysterious elder dragon
heading towards Mezeporta.
We cannot let that happen.
Your job is to intercept and
neutralize the threat.

text.title:
≪GR4 Ancient Tower Survey≫
To Catch a Legend
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I found THE bug-catching
spot! Few would even think
of venturing there... but
someone like you shouldn't
have any trouble. You might
just catch a Hercudrome! Not
like you've got a choice...
A hot tip like that doesn't
come for free, you know!

text.title:
≪GR4 Ancient Tower Survey≫
The King's Tower
text.description:
A Rathalos seems to have
made that mysterious tower
its nest. I need to gather
there to make ends meet,
but with him around I'm
finished! Can you hunt it?

text.title:
≪GR4 Verdant Hills Survey≫
The King of all Skies
text.description:
As you may or may not know,
the Rathalos is often called
the "King of Skies." Well,
I'd like to become just as
strong as the king. I want
to use its fangs as a charm.
Could you hunt one for me?

text.title:
≪GR4 Volcano Survey≫
Volcano Buzzkill
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
The Volcano is literally
swarming with Vespoids. One
of them wouldn't be a big
deal, but THIS? We need some
coal samples to conduct our
research, but as it stands,
we couldn't even hope to get
our hands on one of them.
Mind lending us a hand?

text.title:
≪GR4 Volcano Survey≫
The Scythes Lurking Below
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
We've received reports about
a large group of Ceanataur
in an uncharted part of the
Volcano. They are known to
burrow underground and lie
in wait, making them quite
difficult to find. For the
safety of our investigation,
we ask that you secure the
area.

text.title:
≪GR4 Volcano Survey≫
Gone in a Flash
text.description:
I was out gathering off the
beaten path in the Volcano,
when suddenly an Orgaron
appeared right in front of
me! And then it was GONE!
Just like that! I have no
idea what happened... but,
if you choose to look into
this, PLEASE be careful.

text.title:
≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫
The Poisonous Pack
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I was out exploring the
Volcano when I stumbled
upon an honest to Gog 
treasure trove! I was
raring to go explore,
but the monsters there
proved quite formidable...
Please hunt them down.

text.title:
≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫
Volcano Buzzkill
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
There seems to be a Vespoid
outbreak in an unexplored
part of the Volcano. One of
them wouldn't be a big deal,
but a whole swarm? We need
a coal sample for research
purposes, but now we can't
go and grab it. Could you
help us out?

text.title:
≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫
The Rumbling Volcano
text.description:
During one of our Volcano
surveys, a researcher has
reportedly hit a sleeping
Basarios, causing it to
rampage. The investigation
cannot proceed as long as
the monster is not taken
care of. That's your job.

Complete Main Objective,

back, but... that's no way

Verdant Hills Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,

text.description:

treasure. I'd love to head

text.description:
I hear that a Rathian has

Verdant Hills. I'm sure

lead me to SOME kind of
discovery... Mind helping
me?

text.title:
≪GR3 Great Forest Survey≫
Royal Forest
text.description:
We've received reports of
flying wyverns disrupting
the Great Forest. We need
you to deal with it ASAP.
The area has not yet been
fully surveyed, so please
take all the necessary
precautions.

text.title:
≪GR3 Volcano Survey≫
A Scythe Bathed in Crimson
text.description:
A trade convoy has been
attacked in an uncharted
region of the Volcano. Its

What could have done this?
Please investigate at once.

Reaper of the Marsh

Marshlands. Don't worry, no

text.title:
≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫
Highlands Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Have you heard? They've made
some new discoveries in the
Highlands. It turns out that
certain uncharted regions
are filled to the brim with
rare materials. I could take
you there if you'd like.
Just don't get in my way...

text.title:
≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫
Unpleasant Buzzing
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I was out scaling the cliffs
in an uncharted part of the
Highlands, when suddenly I
was attacked by a swarm of
Vespoids! I've made it out,
but how could I ever come
back after something like
that? Please squash those
pesky bugs!

text.title:
≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫
Stormclad Highlander
text.description:
The Hyujikiki prides itself
on its agility and ferocity.
It is extremely territorial
and attacks everything that
dares intrude on its turf.
We can't do anything about
it without first studying
its ecology more thoroughly.
Please help us investigate.

text.title:
≪GR3 Highlands Survey≫
Storm-forged Thorns
text.description:
I was out exploring, when
suddenly I'd stumbled upon
a sharp needle. I've never
seen anything quite like it
before... Perhaps some kind
of monster left it behind?
Time is of the essence.
Head for the Highlands and
get to the bottom of this.

text.title:
≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Arctic Ridge Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
The Ridge may be harsh and
unrelenting, but its peaks
are surely blessed by Mother
Nature herself. Now, hunting
is all fine and dandy, but
but there's no call to be
hasty. Why not turn your
attention to gathering for
a spell, eh?

text.title:
≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫
The Cold-Blooded Pack
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I was out gathering in the
Arctic Ridge, but a pack of
Giaprey attacked me and I've
lost everything! I won't let
them get in my away again!
Think you could teach them
a lesson for me?

text.title:
≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫
King of the White Pack
text.description:
Having fully conquered the
uncharted regions of the
Arctic Ridge, the Blangonga
seems to be closing in on
inhabited areas. If left
unchecked, it could cause
major damage. You must not
let that happen.

text.title:
≪GR4 Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Blangonga Know No Bounds
text.description:
Say, would you mind hunting
a Blangonga for some fur?
It might be really tough
and bristly, but it makes
for excellent clothing!
All you have to do is hunt
it, I'll do the carving off
myself. Counting on ya'!

text.title:
≪GR4 Volcano Survey≫
Crimson Blitz
text.description:
We are looking for hunters
to help us investigate the
Midogaron. We believe its
solitary lifestyle to be a
byproduct of its immense
strength, which eliminates
the need to travel in a
pack. This is an extremely
dangerous request. Make all
the necessary preparations.

text.title:
≪GR5 Marshlands Survey≫
The Crystal's Red Guard
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Ohh, I've had it with those
Ioprey! They've chosen to
nest at my favorite Quartz
Ore mining spot! How am I
supposed to go there now!?
Please go and mine it for
me! Oh, and if you get rid
of those red fiends, I'll
make sure to reward you
handsomely.

text.title:
≪GR5 Marshlands Survey≫
Marshland Gluttons
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I was out in the swamp, but
then... disaster struck. The
Conga attacked me... again.
Not only did they fart on
me, but they also stole ALL
of my mushrooms! Please get
rid of them! Oh and if you'd
be so kind... Could you help
me gather some mushrooms?

text.title:
≪GR5 Marshlands Survey≫
Reshaping the Marshlands
text.description:
A Gravios has been spotted
in an uncharted part of the
Marshlands. It seems to be
on the hunt for minerals.
We can't allow it to go on.
Otherwise it might just dry
up the whole area with that
heat beam...

text.title:
≪GR5 Volcano Survey≫
Scorching Advance
text.description:
We've discovered a large
set of footprints in the
Volcano. While we can't
be sure, judging by their
size, they may belong to
a Gravios. Track it down
and investigate.

text.title:
≪GR5 Desert Survey≫
A Roar to the Heavens
text.description:
A Tigrex has been spotted
in an uncharted part of the
Desert. According to our
reports, the environment is
harsh, food is scarce, and
the monster is particularly
angry. It needs to be dealt
with before it closes in on
human settlements.

text.title:
≪GR5 Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Arctic Apex
text.description:
A Tigrex showed up out of
nowhere in the Arctic Ridge
and is massacring all the
herbivores! We're in dire
need of food, but at this
rate we're going to starve!
Can you help us?

text.title:
≪GR5 Canyon Survey≫
Lily of the Valley
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
The Canyon is home to a
special variety of cacti.
Their sap is an extremely
valuable substance used in
various medicines. We are
looking for volunteers to
assist us in collecting
said sap.

text.title:
≪GR5 Canyon Survey≫
Canyon Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I'm all out of salt! I was
going to go gather some in
the Canyon, but there's a
swarm of Great Thunderbugs
in the way! Can you deal
with them? It'd be a huge
help if you could get me
some Rock Salt too...

text.title:
≪GR5 Canyon Survey≫
The Great Devourer
text.description:
We've spotted a Pariapuria
in an unsurveyed part of
the Canyon. The situation
is under control, but with
it being so close to a busy
road, disaster's bound to
strike sooner than later.
Are there any hunters up
for the task?

text.title:
≪GR5 Tidal Island Survey≫
A Whirlpool-like Appetite
text.description:
There's a Pariapuria at the
Tidal Island! It showed up
out of nowhere and started
devouring plants and beasts
one after another! At this
rate, the ecosystem will be
ruined! At this time of day,
it might be by the water...
You must hunt it! Hurry!

text.title:
≪GR5 Polar Sea Survey≫
Polar Sea Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
There seems to be a rare
herb found only during the
day in the Polar Sea. The
Guild has tasked us with
gathering some, but despite
our best efforts, we weren't
able to find a single one...
Would you mind helping us
find some?

text.title:
≪GR5 Polar Sea Survey≫
The Frozen White Pack
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I was out investigating the
Polar Sea, when suddenly I
had stumbled upon a pack of
Giaprey. I don't know where
they came from, but I think
it's worth investigating.
Hunt them down and help us
study their ecology.

text.title:
≪GR5 Polar Sea Survey≫
The Vengeful Polar Blade
text.description:
Using its claws, fangs, or
the tail, the Giaorg can
cause large cracks to form
in the ice floor. If kept
unchecked, it could turn
the area into complete ruin,
preventing any further
investigations. It must be
dealt with ASAP.

text.title:
≪GR5 Polar Sea Survey≫
Breaking the Ice
text.description:
I couldn't help but notice
all the cracks in the ice
while surveying the Polar
Sea. I suppose it was the
work of a Giaorg. How about
a little hunt to break the
ice? Just don't get eaten!
It can be quite violent
when chasing down prey...

text.title:
≪GR6 Volcano Survey≫
Researcher Essentials
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
ああ大変だ…。調査に行く時
必要になる火薬草を切らして
しまった…。
あれがないと火を起こすこと
ができず、凍えてしまう！
誰か火薬草と、できれば
起こした火を乗せられる
燃えない器になる物を
持ってきてくれないか！？

text.title:
≪GR6 Volcano Survey≫
Volcano Food Crisis
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
My food supplies are getting
a bit low... Would you mind
hunting a few Aptonoth for
me? Their meat and eggs make
great food. Oh, how about a
Powderstone too? It's great
fuel, you know. Well anyway,
if you've got time, I would
really appreciate it.

text.title:
≪GR6 Volcano Survey≫
Shadow of the Burning Sea
text.description:
A hunter headed for the
Volcano reports to have
seen something swimming
in the lava. It may very
well be a Lavasioth, but
we haven't spotted any of
them in that area. Could
you please head out and
investigate?

text.title:
≪GR6 Volcano Survey≫
Lord of the Lava Sea
text.description:
未調査地域にある火山に、
ヴォルガノスが生息している
ことが分かりました。
ヴォルガノスは溶岩の中を
好き勝手に泳ぎ回るため、
放っておけば噴火してしまう
危険があります。
急ぎヴォルガノスの狩猟に
向かって頂けませんか？

text.title:
≪GR6 Great Forest Survey≫
Venom in the Verdure
text.description:
I was walking through the
bushes when suddenly -- a
sleeping Espinas! I was
shocked, to say the least.
I almost bumped into it and
got one of its thorns into
my arm... I've never seen
one in a place like that!

text.title:
≪GR6 Ancient Tower Survey≫
Thorn-ridden Tower
text.description:
We've received reports about
an Espinas in an uncharted
part of the Ancient Tower.
We've tried our best to
investigate without waking
it from its slumber, but at
some point it attacked us
anyway. We need you to help
us make it out in one piece!

text.title:
≪Grand Tournament≫
Slay the opponent's monster!
text.fail_cond:
Your monster is defeated,
or time expires
text.description:
相手チームのモンスターを
討伐すれば勝利することが
できます！この大闘技会の
大闘技場には、一発逆転が
狙える様々なアイテムが、
地面に眠っています。相手
モンスターを狙うも、アイ
テムを狙うも自由です！

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Desert Specialties
text.description:
Psst... I've found a hidden
gem BRIMMING with treasure.
You've got to check it out.
If you come back with your
Pouch full, it'll be worth
every Zenny spent. You've
got my word.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Marshlands Specialties
text.description:
Psst... I've found a hidden
gem BRIMMING with treasure.
You've got to check it out.
If you come back with your
Pouch full, it'll be worth
every Zenny spent. You've
got my word.

text.description:

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Volcano Specialties
text.description:
Psst... I've found a hidden

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Such is the Great Forest
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
樹海はまだまだ未開の地です。
いきなり狩りに出かけないで、
まずは探索でもどうでしょう？
この地にあると言われている、
あるモンスターのねぐらから
≪かけた貝殻≫を１つだけ
見つけて納品してください。
余裕があればサブもどうぞ。

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Mushrooms, Again
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
お待ちかね。狩場の情報です。
今回の狩場は、鬱蒼と茂る
木々と、どこか神秘的な
空気を感じる樹海です。
生態の調査も兼ねて、
特産キノコ１２個の納品を
お願いします。

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Forest Hypnotist
text.description:
The Great Forest... a land
beyond which no civilization
has ever encroached. We know
not what strange, wonderful
forms of life await us, but
our research can only begin
after securing a foothold in
the locale...

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
The Slumbering Bird
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
やられた…。
砂漠の眠鳥に隊商の車ごと
持って行かれちまった…。
奴は狡猾で、俺たちを眠らせて
から、まんまと積荷だけを
せしめて行くんだ。
ハンターさんよ、奴をどうにか
してくれ。

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Royal Warfare
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
樹海付近を通って、他地方に
抜ける旅人から、飛竜による
被害報告が多数出ておる。
樹海をねぐらとしている飛竜
の数を減らせば、この被害も
ある程度収束するじゃろう。
おぬしらの働きに期待してお
るぞ。

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Great Forest Egg Hunt
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
傷つき、病に苦しむ患者には
滋味ある食物が必要だ。
しかし、そういった食物は
一部富豪の口にしか入らない
のが、現実なのだ。
せめて、広場の患者だけでも
手厚い医療を施したい。
ハンター諸君、頼んだぞ。

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Lava Lurker
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
火山に広がる溶岩の海には
溶岩竜≪ヴォルガノス≫が棲
んでいます。吐き出す溶岩と
巨体を活かした攻撃は一瞬の
油断が死につながります！
特にその巨体を使った突進は
要注意です！

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
Omens of Disaster
text.description:
何やら塔に多くのガブラスが
群れ集っておるようじゃ。
奴らは災厄の前触れとも言われ
ておるゆえ、ギルドとしても
捨ててはおけぬ。
ガブラス８頭を討伐し、状況
を確認してきて欲しい。

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
The Rathalos's Lair
text.description:
The Rathalos is said to nest
somewhere atop the Ancient
Tower. We are looking for
hunters ready to infiltrate
its nest and confirm the
rumors. Heads up! You are
going up against THE King of
the Skies after all...

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
The Azure Rathalos's Lair
text.description:
The Azure Rathalos is said
to nest somewhere atop the
Ancient Tower. We are
looking for hunters ready
to confirm the rumors once
and for all. Your target is
extremely dangerous. Do not
let your guard down.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Arboreal Slumber
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
With their plethora of uses,
the demand for Hypnocatrice
parts is as unrelenting as
always... We ask that you
head to the Great Forest
and hunt the target.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Desert Slumber
text.description:
A fellow wanderer nearly met
his demise in the Desert!
He said that he had suddenly
felt drowsy, had fallen
asleep, and had suffered
from heatstroke. It's got
to be the work of that bird!
Please get rid of it! And do
stay safe!

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Rookie Hunter Support
text.description:
Calling all rookie hunters!
A pesky Bulldrome has been
wreaking havoc to the fields
around Mezeporta. We ask
that you take care of it.
You will be handsomely
rewarded!

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Machalite Mania!
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
When it comes to equipment,
Machalite's bound to show
up at some point... Don't
you just hate going mining
and going back empty-handed?
Well fear not! Hunt a pair
of Velocidrome and you will
be rewarded with at least
two Machalite Ores!

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Into the Fire
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Have you heard of the newly
discovered piscine wyvern?
Its name is Lavasioth, and
I'm off to see it! Or so I
thought... Truth be told I
completely chickened out...
Mind going out and having a
look for me?

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Ruler of the Volcano
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
We've been hired to gather
some ore to fortify Dundorma
against elder dragons, but
we're really feeling the
heat over here! Help us out
will you? Either hunt the
Lavasioth or deliver a few
Powderstones! Counting on
you, brave hunters!

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
The Tigrex's Roar
text.description:
I ran into a beast I had
never laid eyes on before.
Its claws were so strong,
they could probably tear
apart just about anything...
Even them toughest armor
was like a piece of cloth
to them... This one's bound
to put up a real fight!

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Resounding Roar
text.description:
I saw a Tigrex out in the
Ridge! To think that a beast
like that could live in such
a cold region... Looks like
it'll hunt anywhere as long
as there's prey to be taken.

text.title:
≪HRP Quest≫
Azure Hunters (Low)
text.description:
As the name implies, this
Quest will reward you with
a hefty sum of Hunter Rank
points. If you're looking
to rise up the ranks and
take on stronger threats,
this Quest is for you!

≪Zenny Quest≫
Azure Hunters (High)

Quest will reward you with

text.description:

different monster from
anything you've hunted this
far. Its very presence can
transform rain into a storm.
Capturing it is a waste of
time, so concentrate on
steadily hammering away
at it instead.

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
Slay the Velociprey!
text.description:
Velociprey are small
carnivorous bird wyverns
with scaly blue skin.
They're quick on their feet,
so landing an attack can
be difficult. However,
blinding them with a Flash
Bomb should stop them in
their tracks.

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
Slay the Hermitaur!
text.description:
Hermitaurs are small
Carapaceons with incredibly
hard shells. Be careful if
you spy smoke rising from
the ground -- they are known
to lurk underground and
attack any who draw near.
Lob a Sonic Bomb at them,
and victory is yours!

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
Slay the Conga!
text.description:
Conga are small fanged
beasts with pink fur. If
they turn their backs on
you, it's a sign that
they're set to expel a
pungent gas of dubious
origins. It can render
you incapable of using
items, so watch out.

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
Slay the Bullfango!
text.description:
Bullfango are small fanged
beasts with large tusks.
They are pesky foes who
live only to charge head-on
at their target. Draw their
attack, dodge, and then hit
them from behind!

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
Slay the Genprey!
text.description:
Genprey are small meat-
eating bird wyverns that
inhabit the Desert and
resemble Velociprey. Take
a hit from one, and you're
liable to be stunned and
rendered temporarily
defenseless.

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
Slay the Ioprey!
text.description:
Ioprey are small meat-
eating bird wyverns that
resemble Velociprey.
They are known to spit
venom that will gradually
drain your Health on
contact. Should you
become poisoned, use an
Antidote without delay.

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
What's a Velocidrome!?
text.description:
The Velocidrome is the
leader of the Velociprey
pack, with a larger body
and more prominent crest.
Just think of it as a larger
and tougher version of a
Velociprey and slash away!

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
Hunt the Velocidrome!
text.description:
Now, onto the hunt proper.
Hunt down a Velocidrome in
the Jungle. Be aware that
in the wild, this beast is
liable to run away to a
nearby area to recover
health when injured.

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
What's a Bulldrome!?
text.description:
The Bulldrome is the
leader of the Bullfango
family, and is notable for
its larger body and tusks.
As you can probably imagine,
it’s a somewhat reckless
foe, so use the same tactics
you employ when battling a
Bullfango.

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
Hunt the Bulldrome!
text.description:
Now then, on to the real
hunt! Hunt down a Bulldrome
in the Jungle. Bulldromes
you encounter in the wild
are liable to run away to
a nearby area to recover
health when injured.

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
What's a Gendrome!?
text.description:
The Gendrome is the extra-
large leader of the Genprey
pack. More aggressive than
a Velocidrome, it will hit
back if you get too greedy
with your attacks. Watch out
for its stun attack, too.

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
Hunt the Gendrome!
text.description:
Now, on to the real hunt!
Hunt down a Gendrome in the
Desert! It's cold out there
at night, so be sure to take
a Hot Drink to stay warm, or
your max Stamina will
gradually decrease.

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
What's an Iodrome!?
text.description:
The Iodrome is the leader
of the Ioprey pack, with
a distinctive larger body
and purple crest. Utilize
all you have learned up to
now, and you should be able
to overcome this beast, but
beware of its vicious and
venomous spit!

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
Hunt the Iodrome!
text.description:
Now then, on to the real
hunt! Track down an Iodrome
in the Marshlands. At night,
poisonous spots appear on
the ground, so today's hunt
will take place during
daylight hours. Good luck
out there!

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
What's a Yian Kut-Ku?
text.description:
The Yian Kut-Ku is a bird-
like wyvern notable for its
large ears and beak.
Sensitive to loud sounds, it
can be stunned, but be sure
to exercise caution -- after
being stunned, it will grow
enraged, and become even
more powerful than usual.

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
Hunt the Yian Kut-Ku!
text.description:
Now then, on to the real
hunt! Track down a Yian
Kut-Ku in the Jungle.
Knowing your enemy, and
countering its attacks
accordingly, is the key
to a successful hunt. Take
the tail for example -- it
only spins counterclockwise!

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
Deliver a Carnivore Egg!
text.description:
You'll often find eggs,
including Carnivore Eggs,
in corners where scattered
bones lie, or on slightly
elevated sections. If you
do manage to get hold of a
Carnivore Egg, deliver it
by bringing it back to the
Red Box in the Camp.

text.title:
≪Hunter Basics≫
The Absolute Basics
text.description:
It's your trusty instructor
once again. The Quest Info
column is jam-packed with
important info such as the
contract fee needed to take
on a Quest, the reward
received when a Quest is
cleared, the Quest goals,
and the time limit.

text.title:
≪Hunter Basics≫
Hunter Gathering
text.description:
Here's another lesson from
your favorite instructor.
Kudos for checking here.
No matter what the Quest,
be sure to check here.
On this Quest, you'll be
hunting for Honey. Find a
beehive, and it's as good
as yours!

text.title:
≪Hunter Basics≫
Combining Basics
text.description:
All set for today's lesson?
Now, every object has a set
combo success rate, so if at
first you don't succeed,
try, try again! You'll find
Combo recipes in the Combo
List in the Start Menu.

text.title:
≪Hunter Basics≫
Fishing Fundamentals
text.description:
You guessed it--it's your
one and only instructor!
Now, the fish inhabiting
fishing points differ in
each location, so remember
where to net the fish you
need. The type of fish also
changes with the season. Ah,
the wonder of mother nature!

text.title:
≪Hunter Basics≫
Sword School
text.description:
Now listen up, 'cos this is
important! You need to bag
5 Velociprey to clear this
Quest. Once you get the hang
of handling your weapon,
it's time to hone your
hunting skills. Keep your
eyes peeled for blue scales!

text.title:
≪Hunter Basics≫
Stolen Egg Scramble
text.description:
Now let me, AHEM, eggsplain
something to you. Take a hit
when carrying an egg and the
yolk will be on you. Pay
attention to what's going on
around you by panning the
camera using {K073}{K080}{K068}{K069}.
Oh, and if your stamina runs
out, say g'bye to that egg.

text.title:
≪Hunter Basics≫
Basic Hunting
text.description:
The battle with the 
Velocidrome begins! Make
good use of the items
supplied, and give it your
all! Once you're adept at
slaying your prey, study the
art of monster capture in
order to diversify your
hunting options.

Golden Groan
text.success_cond:

text.description:

of Subquest? Don't worry --
we'll keep track of the
damage you deal, so you can
focus on the Main Objective.

to the task?

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Arctic Delivery
text.description:
Delivering items is a vital
part of a hunter's job, and
here at the Guild, we do all
we can to support hunters as
they discharge their duties.
The Arctic Ridge, with its
drops and dips, is an ideal
place to show off your
transportation skills.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Marine Moresco
text.description:
A Plesioth with a Daimyo
Hermitaur... A curious
combination, but they've
been discovered together
in the Jungle. Top-class
hunters will no doubt
welcome the chance to get
their hands on these two
marine monsters. Happy
hunting!

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Paw in Claw
text.description:
We've received a report that
an unusual monster pairing
has been seen in the swamp.
To think that a Congalala
would team up with a Shogun
Ceanataur... This looks like
it would be well worth
further investigation.

text.title:
≪Extra Quest≫
A Tour of the Jungle (LR)
text.description:
It's what you've all been
waiting for! Yes, it's time
for an Extra Quest, courtesy
of the Public Tavern. We've
provided a lovely, quiet
area for you to gather items
to your heart's content.
Enjoy!

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Egg Dream!
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Spring has come! Head to
the Jungle at night and
snatch those eggs! You
may be rewarded with Gold
or Silver Eggs. Selling
those will net you a tidy
sum! If you're looking to
strike it rich, do not
waste this opportunity!

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Felyne Showdown!
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
As if Felynes and Melynxes
weren't enough, a couple of
Velocidrome have even found
their way into the Arena!
Your job is to take out 2
Felynes, but there's a fin
reward waiting for you if
you deal with 40 Melynxes
too!

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Vespoid Outbreak
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Listen to my tale! I found a
vast forest in an unexplored
region. No sooner did I set
foot in it than I faced a
huge swarm of Vespoids. I 
escaped with my life, but I
left my precious belongings.
Won't someone chase that
hideous herd away for me?

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Hornetaur Outbreak
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
No sooner had that wretched
swarm disappeared than I was
up to my eyes in a horrible
horde of Hornetaurs. My
precious belongings are
still there. Won't someone
get rid of those beasts?

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Yian Garuga Attacks!
text.description:
A noble hunter such as I
must tread a solitary path.
And yet I will share some
useful information with the
amateur hunters who make
Dundorma their base. The
Garuga, a lone wolf like
me, is nearby. This fierce
beast awaits challengers...

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
A Rouge King
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
So I licked my wounds from
my last misadventure, and
got back on the proverbial
horse. All was going well
until th-that thing with its
head ablaze... Now, listen!
I beseech you! Join forces
with me and let us finish
this job.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Royal Warfare - Reprise
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
We had believed that the
wyvern incident was dealt
with, but more reports are
coming in of folks in the
Great Forest coming under
attack. We ask that you
head back there and deal
with this airborne threat.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Ore Hunters Assemble!
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Iron Ore is essential for
improving your equipment.
Ensure you don't run low
at the wrong moment by
achieving the Main Target
in this Quest and earning
no less than 7 hunks of
precious Iron Ore!

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Jungle Relaxation
text.description:
Bring me supplies for the
medicine I'm researching,
and I'll make it worth your
while. I'll give you any
leftover potion materials
so you can try out some
combining for yourself.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Extra Order: Forest Eggs
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
My poor, suffering patients
need nutritious food. At the
very least, I wish I could
do something for my patients
here in the Square, but
supplies are thin on the
ground. Perhaps you could
help me out?

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
Verdant Hills Specialties
text.description:
The distant Verdant Hills
are bursting with all manner
of natural bounty. Ambitious
hunters aiming for a Rank of
51 should be well able to
make the most of the items
on offer. I highly recommend
that you take a trip there.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Grocery Bonanza
text.description:
The mating season's in full
swing, monsters are out and
about, and that means lots
of business from hunters.
Trouble is, it's hard to
keep up with demand. Could
you get some supplies for
me? There's a reward in it!

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Grocery Crisis
text.description:
Ah, winter's here and it
makes getting supplies in
a real pain in the neck.
I don't suppose you could
lend a hand, could you?
I've got an exclusive,
hand-picked ingredient
to give you as a reward.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Grocery Order
text.description:
Ah, the hot weather brings
customers in their droves!
They want healthy fare to
stop the heat draining them.
Business is good, but I'd
sure appreciate some help
getting supplies. You'll
be rewarded with my own
exclusive ingredient!

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Raging Gunpowder
text.description:
I want it! I need it! I MUST
have it! What do I want, you
ask? Why, adorable Kut-Ku
furniture, of course! Hunt
them down for me and I'll
give you gunpowder materials
I stole from the storeroom!
Don't miss out!

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Piece of Cake
text.description:
There aren't too many takers
for odd jobs, so the Guild
has combined a few tasks,
and prepared a suitable
reward. It's an easy mission
to do while you're out
mining, but remember your
Pickaxe or you'll definitely
have to retire defeated.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Easy Pickings
text.description:
Hunters are often not keen
on small tasks, but the
little jobs are important,
too. This is a great Quest
for hunters who have just
risen up the ranks, and want
to stock up on supplies. But
you won't get far without
packing your Pickaxe!

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Bow Bonus
text.description:
A dazzling reward awaits all
aficionados of the fine art
of bowmanship. High-ranking
hunters can now get their
hands on a fine collection
of Gunner Equipment. It's
a nice, easy Quest, so why
not form a party and take
it on?

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
The Source of Life
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
We're offering you a great
chance to stock up on meat.
Take a trip to the home
of the Aptonoth, and you'll
find there's meat in
plentiful supply.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Gladiatorial Garuga
text.description:
To the hunters of Dundorma,
I bring you news of a beast
after my own heart, a lone
wolf, the Yian Garuga.
I sense that it is ready for
a fight to the death, so any
who hunt it must be prepared
to kill or be killed.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Vespoid Outbreak!
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Listen to my tale! I found a
vast forest in an unexplored
region. No sooner did I set
foot in it than I faced a
huge swarm of Vespoids. I 
escaped with my life, but I
left my precious belongings.
Won't someone chase that
hideous herd away for me?

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Hornetaur Outbreak!
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
No sooner had that wretched
swarm disappeared than I was
up to my eyes in a horrible
horde of Hornetaurs. My
precious belongings are
still there. Won't someone
get rid of those beasts?

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
Harbingers of Horror
text.description:
The Tower appears to have
been overrun by Remobra.
These beasts are known as
harbingers of calamity, so
the Guild cannot sit idly
by. Investigate the
situation, and slay 8
Remobra while you're at it!

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Black Horns
text.description:
A Diablos has been sighted,
its black body striking any
who see it dumb with horror.
There is believed to be only
one, so any capable hunter
should be able to deal with
it. But if you take victory
for granted, you may be in
for a rude awakening.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Neodymium: Hypnocatrice
text.description:
Ancient notes about crafting
techniques, believed to have
been lost to time, have been
found on monsters in various
locales! If you happen to
get your hands on one, bring
it to me at once! I'll show
you what a real man can do!

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
Delivery Work
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Think huntin's just about
baggin' big bad monsters?
You got it dead wrong!
Bein' a hunter also means
you gotta do your share
of heavy liftin'. And that's
good, honest work. So, you
ready to work up a sweat
or what?

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
The Red Wing's Trail
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
How about trying a new kind
of Subquest? Don't worry --
we'll keep track of the
damage you deal, so you can
focus on the Main Objective.
What do you say? Are you up
to the task?

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Fistful of Fish
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Up ahead, where I'm going
to hawk my wares, they've
got no taste. They rate
moldy old mushrooms higher
than fish! Can you believe
it!? If you can supply me
with fungus, I'll reward
you with the finest fish
you've ever smelled!

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
The Budding Great Forest
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
As hunters rise up the
ranks, they tend to head
out on hunt after hunt
without taking time to rest.
We hope that heading out
to the Great Forest this
time will be a welcome
break from the norm.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Trap Tutor
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Good traps don't attract
attention. Oh no. A trap
worthy of the name waits
quietly in the shadows.
First, gather the right
components. The Great Forest
is a fine place to build a
trap with locally-sourced
items, so go get 'em!

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Shot in the Arm
text.description:
This request just in from a
Guild associate. It's just
some minor tasks, but the
reward is a healing tonic
that can help you out of a
tight spot, anytime. This
Energy Drink has the Guild's
gold-plated seal of approval.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Honest Gathering
text.description:
The first step to hunting
success is a good approach
to gathering items. The
Guild has prepared this
Quest to ensure you don't
forget this important first
principle. Work hard, and
you'll blossom just like the
reward -- an Adamant Seed.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
The Fierce Blue Talon
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
In accordance with recent
Elder Hall recommendations,
we've decided to try out a
a new type of Subquest. The
Guild will keep track of the
damage dealt to the target,
so you can concentrate on
the Main Objective!

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
The Azure Hypnotist
text.description:
I hear that during Spring,
Hypnocatrice bodies turn a
vivid azure. Now's the time
to try to catch a glimpse.
But you'd better hurry
before someone beats you
to it!

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Azure Hypnocatrice
text.description:
If I could only get hold of
a rare and gloriously Blue
Hypno Pelt, I'd make myself
a dress and be undisputed
belle of the ball. Could
you get me one?

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
The Red Magma Wyvern
text.description:
This afternoon I decided to
pay a sly visit to the lair
of the Lavasioth. I nearly
dropped my weapons in shock
when I saw a Lavasioth of a
shade I'd never seen before.
I got roughed up bad before
I escaped. I'd reward anyone
who hunted that thing down.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
The Tigrex's Roar
text.description:
The Tigrex is a beast that
boasts overwhelming power,
but no monster in this world
is without its weak point.
I've analyzed this, and I
believe its head to be
vulnerable. Aim to strike
it as it turns around.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
The Dominant Power
text.description:
I may have underestimated
my opponent. Even if you're
used to facing its kind,
no two monsters are the
same, and this is a tough
customer, believe me. Do
not drop your guard till
you've finished the job.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Gathering: Jungle (Summer)
text.description:
The Dyegrass is a rare plant
that only seasoned experts,
well-versed in nature, can
tell apart from its many
imitations. For this reason,
we have prepared a special
Quest tailored to HR100
hunters.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Gathering: A.Ridge (Spring)
text.description:

that only seasoned experts,

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Crafting: Lrg Armor Spheres
text.description:
Tis' a fine thing to have a
new way to improve armor,
but it's going to require
Armor Spheres. When it comes
to making them, I'm your
man. There are a few types,
but let's focus on the Large
Armor Spheres for now. Bring
me those fragments!

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
The Den of Dread
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I needed to know what sort
of creature lurked in the
virgin terrain of the Great
Forest, but what I found
there... Just thinking of
it sends a chill down my
spine. I left some of my
friends there. Please, you
must help me!

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Lone Horn
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The solitary one-horned
wyvern Monoblos is one of
the twin rulers of the
Desert alongside the
Diablos. To hunt one alone
is the mark of a top-class
hunter. Are you up to the
challenge?

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
The White Horn's Wrath
text.description:
A white wyvern thought to be
an extremely rare Monoblos
subspecies has arrived on
the scene. Only a hunter
in a class of their own
could hope to hunt this
beast alone. Are you up to
the challenge?

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
The Fallen Sun
text.description:
The Lunastra is an elder
dragon said to be born
of flame -- an avatar of
the inferno. We can send
but a single Hunter on an
expedition to the frontier
lands where it resides.
Who can fly solo and slay
this beast?

the inferno. We can send
but a single Hunter on an
expedition to the frontier
lands where it resides.
Who can fly solo and slay
this beast?

we can send but one hunter.

the beast, but slay it if
you can!

≪Jungle Survey≫
Warrior of Valor
text.description:
There was once a hunter so
brave and strong that their
name lives on in the annals
of the Guild. But even that
warrior was forced to give
up when facing the Plesioth.
We have a handsome reward
for any hunter who can fly
solo and slay this beast.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Ruler of the Fiery Sea
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
In accordance with recent
Elder Hall recommendations,
we've decided to try out a
a new type of Subquest. The
Guild will keep track of the
damage dealt to the target,
so you can concentrate on
the Main Objective!

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
The Forest Lord's Awakening
text.description:
In the depths of the forest
it lurked, waiting quietly,
biding its time until its
prey appeared... Its power
is beyond formidable, and
any who would hunt it must
beware of its poisonous
thorns.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
The Deities of Death
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Terrifying Black Diablos
have been sighted. Those
who have been engulfed in
their shadows know them as
the Deities of Death. Is
there a hunter who dares
to take up arms against
these Desert-stalking
demons?

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Red and Black Armor
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Hey, d'you hear about that
Lavasioth subspecies they
discovered? Well, you're
lookin' at the guy who's
gonna take it out.
...What's that!? A black
subspecies has been seen,
too? Then I guess we can
split the honors between us.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
The Ravaging Rainstorm
text.description:
The Kushala Daora is a
different monster from
anything you've hunted this
far. Its very presence can
transform rain into a storm.
Capturing it is a waste of
time, so concentrate on
steadily hammering away
at it instead.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
The Jungle Phantom
text.description:
The Chameleos is an outcast
among the elder dragons.
It's almost as if the Jungle
rain is on his side, as it
grows more intense when he's
nearby. Trying to capture
him is a waste of time, so
concentrate on steadily
hammering away instead.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Sandy Stormbringer
text.description:
The Kushala Daora is far
removed from any monster
you've hunted this far.
It will likely throw your
own powerlessness into
stark relief. Don't even
try to capture it, focus
on steadily wearing it
down instead.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Scorched by the Sands
text.description:
The Teostra is an elder
dragon said to be an avatar
of the inferno. Its ferocity
puts it in a terrifying
class all its own. Don't
even think about trying to
capture it, just hammer
away and wear it down.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
The Silent Swamp
text.description:
The Chameleos is an outcast
among the Elder Dragons. It
is capable of vanishing in
a flash, making it feared
even by the most elite of
hunters. Trying to capture
it is no use. Concentrate
on steadily hammering away
instead.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Ruler of the Flame
text.description:
The Teostra is said to be an
avatar of the inferno. Its
fiery cloak will mercilessly
sap away at your Health at
close range... You have no
hope of capturing it. Focus
on steadily wearing it down
instead.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Phantom of the Snowfield
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
The elder dragon Kirin is
so rare that it is known
as a Mythical Beast, and
has no fixed habitat. Oh,
and if you make it to the
summit, be sure to plant
the Guild Flag up there!

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Steel Stormbringer
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
The Kushala Daora is far
removed from any monster
you've hunted this far.
It will likely throw your

down instead.

≪Volcano Survey≫
Emperor of Flame
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
The Teostra is said to be an
avatar of the inferno, with
all the fire and heat of the
Volcano at its command. You
have no hope of capturing
it, so concentrate instead
on steadily hammering away.

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
Misty Maestro
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
The Chameleos is an outcast
among the Elder Dragons. It
is so rare that, even now,
many question its existence!
Trying to capture it is no
use. You'd best concentrate
on steadily hammering away
instead.

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
Lightning Strikes the Tower
text.description:
A mythical Kirin has been
spotted at a Tower located
in an uncharted land. The
Tower can only be accessed
when the climate is just
right. In other words, now
is the time!

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
The Eldest of Dragons
text.description:
Curious reports reach us of
a moving mountain in the
mysterious hunting grounds
around the Tower. If our
suspicions are correct, this
may spell serious trouble.
Investigate these reports
and, if necessary, take
matters into your own hands.

large amount of Aqra Vashim
hatchlings this year. This
could be a chance to strike
it big! Its resilience stems
from its bodily fluid, which
some think can grant eternal
youth. So... wanna get rich?

One Shot, One Kill?
text.description:
We've confirmed reports
of an extremely powerful
Bulldrome in the swamps.
Head out and eliminate it
ASAP! Do not underestimate
it. You WILL regret it!

Ancient Hymn
text.description:
Once upon a time, in a land
far, far away, I'd heard a
most wonderful melody. I've
been a performer for a very
long time, but that melody
stirred my very soul. If
you manage to complete the
Quest with what I provide,
I will award you with its
score...

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Red and Blue Horrors
text.description:
This Quest is aimed at elite
hunters. A rambunctious band
of wyverns are running riot
in the Arena, grouped round
an Aberrant Velocidrome and
Iodrome. To suppress these
troublemakers, you'll need
to set your sights on these
two beasts.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Amber Assault
text.success_cond:
Hunt one of the target
monsters
text.description:
This Quest is aimed at elite
hunters. A pair of Aberrant
Gendromes have been sighted
in the Desert. They are very
aggressive, so proceed with
extreme caution, and try
to take out a pair of them.
If that's too tall an order,
try bagging just the one.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Enchanting Bloodstone
text.description:
According to ancient texts,
there exists a subspecies of
the Aqra Vashim, called the
Aqra Jebia. The fact that no
document depicts it without
its tail speak volumes about
its stregnth. Ambition can
sure be fatal...

≪Great Forest Survey≫
Vespoid Outbreak!
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Listen to my tale! I found a
vast forest in an unexplored
region. No sooner did I set
foot in it than I faced a
huge swarm of Vespoids. I 
escaped with my life, but I
left my precious belongings.
Won't someone chase that
hideous herd away for me?

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Hornetaur Outbreak!
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
No sooner had that wretched
swarm disappeared than I was
up to my eyes in a horrible
horde of Hornetaurs. My
precious belongings are
still there. Won't someone
get rid of those beasts?

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
Harbingers of Horror
text.description:
The Tower appears to have
been overrun by Remobra.
These beasts are known as
harbingers of calamity, so
the Guild cannot sit idly
by. Investigate the
situation, and slay 8
Remobra while you're at it!

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
The Great Sprouting Forest
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
As hunters rise up the
ranks, they tend to head
out on hunt after hunt
without taking time to rest.
We hope that heading out
to the Great Forest this
time will be a welcome
break from the norm.

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Canyon Specialities
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
You're sure to find items
the like of which you've
never seen in the wilderness
of the Canyons. Really
gets the old heart racing,
doesn't it? I'd strongly
recommend you head out on
a little expedition...

text.description:
Just one... If only I could
obtain one ultra-rare beak
from a bird wyvern... The
Golden Trophy would be mine!
I'm willing to bet my entire
collection here! Capture the
funkiest-looking one you can
find! Make sure to use the
right weapon too. We can't
risk damaging the goods!

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Fin Gathering
text.success_cond:
Capture the target monster,
or complete Subquest A or B
text.description:
Fins are the future of fine
dining, and I need to get
myself a sample right away. 
Please use the weapons I
provide and hunt a Plesioth.
You're most welcome to the
leftovers. I'm positively
slavering at the thought...

text.description:

about Aberrant monsters, and
how hard it is to get your
hands on their sacs. Well,
that's where I come in! All
you've got to do is capture
the monster. I've sprinkled
in some Subquests to make
your life easier, too. Good
luck!

their blood and secretions.

us to harvest the samples
directly. Could you do that
for me? How about I reward
you with... the monster's
bodily fluids?

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
The Advent of Thunder
text.description:
The wild Canyon, long seen
as a worthless wasteland,
turned out to be the habitat
of the elusive Belkuros.
Boasting an elder dragon's
strength, it represents a
chance for hunters to show
what they've really got.

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Spring Thunder
text.description:
Veteran hunters have been
returning in their droves
nursing bloodied noses and
bruised pride, courtesy of
the Belkuros. To prevent
further mishaps, we've
prepared some special
Supply Items, so use
them wisely...

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Bolt From the Blue
text.description:
More hunters have beat hasty
retreats in the face of the
Belkuros. We hope to learn
a great deal more about this
bellicose beast soon, but
till then, be very careful.
We will naturally provide
more Supply Items this time.

text.title:
≪Frontier Quest≫
To Victory and Beyond
text.description:
Attention all hunters!
The Guild's Central Council
is mobilizing its forces
against the Akantor. The
beast has been pushed back
to the Volcano, but a brave
hunter needs to step up and
take it down.

text.title:
≪Elder Dragon Quest≫
Showdown at Castle Schrade!
text.description:
The mythical black dragon
has been spotted in Castle
Schrade. Legends say that
this beast will bring
calamity and chaos to the
entire world. You must
make a stand to prevent
this prophecy from being
fulfilled.

text.title:
≪Elder Dragon Quest≫
Red Rage Pursuit
text.description:
Fatalis, the black dragon of
legend, is holed up deep in
a volcanic lair where no man
has ever set foot. We cannot
afford to leave it to its
nefarious devices or it will
surely spell disaster for
the entire world. You must
make a stand against it.

text.title:
≪Elder Dragon Quest≫
Old Fatalis
text.description:
A beast that is not referred
to in any of our official
literature has been sighted
in the mysterious Tower.
Could this really be the
Ancestral Dragon whose name
has been fearfully whispered
through the ages?

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Aberrant Espinas Research
text.success_cond:
Capture the main target, or
damage the specified parts
text.description:
In order to investigate the
ecology of Aberrant flying
wyverns, we need samples of
their blood and secretions.
Capturing them would allow
us to harvest the samples
directly. Could you do that
for me? How about I reward
you with... the monster's
bodily fluids?

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
The Avatar of Gluttony
text.description:
峡谷に呑竜が現れたようね…。
呑竜には、特に欲される素材
もないから、いつもならギル
ドも狩猟手配はしないのだけ
れど、今回は、ある筋からの
依頼があるので、特別に支給
品付きで狩猟を発注するわ…。
有効に使うことね…。

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Gold Pawprint Coins
text.description:
Whenever you get a hankering
for Pawprint Coins, come to
the Canyon with a Completion
Ticket. And come alone. I
await your visit...

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Pawprint Coin Pursuit
text.description:
I was heading back from
the Canyon when a gang
of fiendish Felynes and
malicious Melynxes struck.
At this rate, I'll never
deliver these goods. Help
me out and I'll give you a
ticket you can trade for
Pawprint Coins.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Dealing No.001
text.description:
Listen, no one's going to
save your backside if you
mess up. You know what I'm
asking for, now go out and
get it. And go alone. I'm
not having groups ganging up
and plotting against me...

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Simian Shell Shock
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective, or
Subquest A
text.description:
The Arena's the place for
hunters to really show off
their skills. This time
you'll be facing a team of
Hermitaurs and Blangongas.
Your job is to slay 20
Hermitaurs, but there's a
great reward for anyone who
takes both parties out.

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Toxic Arena
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective, or
Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Arena's the place for
hunters to really show off
their skills. Surrounded by
venomous threats striking
from surface and air, only
the most courageous souls
will be able to survive
this challenge.

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Lynian Feast
text.description:
The Arena's the place for
hunters to really show off
their skills. The horde of
Shakalakas awaiting you
would daunt all but the
hardiest hunter. If you feel
confident you can take them
out, step into the Arena.

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
The Wyvern Monarchy
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective, or
Subquest A or B
text.description:
For eons the Rathalos and
Rathian have ruled land and
air respectively. No one who
takes on these regal beasts
should do it without being
aware that it could be their
last battle. Be aware that
you can only lay one Shock
Trap and one Pitfall Trap.

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Venom meets Hypnosis
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective, or
Subquest A
text.description:
The Arena's the place for
hunters to really show off
their skills. This deadly
double act of wyverns
symbolizes the twin threats
of hypnosis and deadly
venom. Avoid their assaults
and use the Supply Items
to turn the tables.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Tigrex Terror
text.description:
We've received an SOS from
Hunters who were ambushed by
two Tigrexes. If you think
you're up to the task, head
there to take on this twin
threat and save the besieged
hunters.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Tigrex Threat
text.description:
We're received an SOS from
an expeditionary force of
hunters who set out to face
the Tigrex threat. It looks
like the dual assault proved
too much. Time is of the
essence -- get out there and
save them!

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Jungle Wyvern Research
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective, or
Subquest A
text.description:
I've got a fine mission for
you. Strap on all your gear
and take aim at the wyverns
of the world. Rookie hunters
will find this a bit of a
handful, but I've got some
heavy-duty equipment for
you, so try to get to grips
with all your weaponry.

text.description:

waiting for! Yes, it's time
for an Extra Quest, courtesy
of the Public Guild! We've
prepared some volcanic
terrain for you to explore.
Just be aware that the lava
lakes are still off-limits.

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Seeking Pawprint Coins
text.description:
I was on my way back from
the Canyon, when suddenly
I got ambushed by a pack of
Felynes & Melynxes! At this
rate, I'm never going to
make that delivery! Help me
out and I will give you a
Completion Ticket. You can
use it to get your hands on
some Pawprint Coins!

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Dreaming of Pawprint Coins
text.description:
I'm in trouble! A Shogun
Ceanataur happens to be
RIGHT where I was supposed
to make a delivery! Help me
out, will you? I will give
you a Completion Ticket as
thanks. You can use it to
get some Pawprint Coins!

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
The Hunt for Pawprint Coins
text.description:
I'm one step away from the
Canyon, but there's a Yian
Garuga in the way, and I
can't go any further! Help
me out, will you? I will
give you a Completion Ticket
as thanks. You can use it
to get some Pawprint Coins!

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Gold Pawprint Coins
text.description:
Hey! Thanks again for that
other time. If it's Pawcoins
you want, I'm afraid you're
going to have to come visit
me in the Canyon. Just make
sure you've got the ticket.
I'll be waiting for you!
