text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
The Heroic Gray Wolf
text.description:
A skin-crawling howling has
been echoing round the caves
in the swamp. We believe it
to be a gray fanged beast
known as the Kamu Orgaron.
We would like to do further
research, and would
be grateful if you could
assist us...

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
The Noble White Wolf
text.description:
A skin-crawling howling has
been echoing round the caves
in the swamp. We believe it
to be a white fanged beast
known as the Nono Orgaron.
We would like to do further
research, and would
be grateful if you could
assist us...

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Desert Sakura
text.description:
We've received reports of
a brilliant pink-colored
Rathian in the Desert.
Anyone who thinks they have
what it takes to hunt this
extremely rare subspecies
should make themselves
known at the Quest Counter!

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Black Horns
text.description:
A Diablos has been sighted,
its black body striking any
who see it dumb with horror.
There is believed to be only
one, so any capable hunter
should be able to deal with
it. But if you take victory
for granted, you may be in
for a rude awakening.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Master the Flash Bomb
text.description:
You'll have nothing to fear
once you've mastered the art
of flinging a Flash Bomb in
front of a monster's eyes
and blinding them with a
powerful flash of light.
Flash Bombs can be found in
the Supply Box, so feel free
to use them at will.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Blue Yian Kut-Ku Sighted
text.description:
If ever you hear a curious
birdlike cry in the Jungle,
it's sure to be the creature
known as the Yian Kut-Ku. A
Yian Kut-Ku normally has a
pink body, but this one is
rumored to be blue. Could be
an intriguing subspecies...

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Desert Sakura
text.description:
We've received reports of
a brilliant pink-colored
Rathian in the Desert.
Anyone who thinks they have
what it takes to hunt this
extremely rare subspecies
should make themselves
known at the Quest Counter!

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Hunting in an Arctic Land
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Don't forget to pack some
Hot Drinks before heading
to the Arctic Ridge. Why
not get acclimatized to the
frosty slopes by slaying
Popos before taking on the
Bulldrome?

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
The Red Shadow
text.description:
A red shadow's been sighted
slithering through the snow.
It's sure to be a Red Khezu.
The Blangos are searching
for food together in packs,
so take care not to run into
both beasts together.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
The White Shadow
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Khezu spend their larval
stage entirely underground,
so their sense of smell is
believed to be superior to
their eyesight. If the hunt
runs into trouble, trade the
Khezu Whelps in the ground
with the Veggie Elder and
deliver what he gives you.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Lord of the Beasts
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Arctic Ridge is overrun
with countless Blango this
season. Acting on the orders
of their leader, Blangonga,
they attack in packs. Don't
let them surround you.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Lord of the Beasts
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Blangonga is the ruler of
the Arctic Ridge, and will
attack anyone who strays
onto its turf. Also, a rare
breed of Velociprey has come
in order to nest. They won't
want you touching their
eggs...

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Lord of the Beasts
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Hunting the Iodrome in the
Volcano may well prove to
be a headache. When its
health is low, it has a
nasty habit of fleeing to
an inhospitable spot where
your health will be drained.
The trick is to not to let
it escape.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
The Trap Lurking in the Rock
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
If you plan to go after the
Basarios, keep a careful eye
on the rocky regions, since
it will often try to blend
into the terrain. If your
mind is set on mining, then
be sure to gather some Coal.
It's an excellent energy
source.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
The Trap Lurking in the Rock
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Basarios eats ore to
grow, so its outer shell
can often contain the stuff.
Destroy its body parts and
you may save yourself the
trouble of having to mine.
Two stones, one bird!

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Infernal Overlord
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Owing to a diet heavy in
ore and coal, the Gravios
boasts an incredibly hard
outer shell that takes
seriously robust weapons to
penetrate. If you're not
having any luck, you can
always try sneaking some
Powderstones instead...

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
A Subspecies Clad in Black
text.description:
A Black Gravios, stained by
volcanic smoke and ash, has
appeared. One look at it
will make your blood curdle.
Still, if it's just a wyvern
encased in armor, surely
you just need to smash that
armor...

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
The Shogun of Sky and Earth
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its curious limbs to climb
to great heights. Should
you have trouble with the
hunt, try focusing on the
Remobra to get valuable
food ingredients instead.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
The Shogun of Sky and Earth
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Shogun Ceanataur uses
its curious limbs to climb
to great heights. This is
also the season when you'll
find large numbers of young
Ceanataurs in the Volcano.
Beware of their sharp claws.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Part Break: Wyvern Hardfang
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster,
or complete Subquest A or B
text.description:
Here at the Mezeporta Clan
Association, we make it an
effort to reward hunters who
excel at breaking Aberrant
monster parts. Complete the
Quest to obtain a rare mate-
rial! Be advised that the
ticket used to initiate the
Quest will be lost upon
departure.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Capture: Wyvern Hardbone
text.success_cond:

text.description:

effort to reward hunters who

monsters. Complete the Quest
to obtain a rare material!
Be advised that the ticket
used to initiate the Quest
will be lost upon departure.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Winner's Coin Exchange
text.description:
I heard there's a collector
of VS Tickets residing in
the Jungle who'll trade them
for Winner's Coins. If it's
true, this tip is gold dust.
Those coins don't grow on
trees, you know.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
The Angler's Path: Rookie
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Plesioth is hunted
text.description:
Fishing is a solitary
pursuit that requires
patience and dedication.
Your job this time is to
catch a Plesioth and
deliver 10 small fish
prints. Be sure to reel
in the Plesioth without
capturing it.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
The Angler's Path: Reel Pro
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Green Plesioth is hunted
text.description:
Fishing is a solitary
pursuit that requires
patience and dedication.
As a reward, you will
receive materials that
serve as proof of your
mastery. Be sure to reel
in the Green Plesioth
without capturing it.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Harvest Mining - Part 1
text.description:
You've come a long way,
haven't you? Hunting is
great, but mining is fun
too! How about you give
it a shot? I want you to
collect a lot of specific
ores. You'll get yourself
a special reward if you do.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Harvest Gathering - Part 2
text.description:
Back at it gathering today?
Instead of worrying about
tools, you want to focus on
getting new armor, right?
Well, I've got another favor
to ask. It might be a bit
harder than last time, but
please do your best. It'll
be worth it.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Harvest Gathering - Part 1
text.description:
Good day, nice to meet you.
Have you been gathering out
on a hunt? I think it's high
time you showed us how far
you've come. Naturally, you
will be handsomely rewarded.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Harvest Gathering - Part 2
text.description:
Back at it gathering today?
Instead of worrying about
tools, you want to focus on
getting new armor, right?
Well, I've got another favor
to ask. It might be a bit
harder than last time, but
please do your best. It'll
be worth it.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Harvest Mining - Finale
text.description:
Time for my final request.
"Are you going to ask me to
go mining again?" -- No, all
I want you to do is exchange
the coins you've obtained so
far. By the way, I've never
had Khezu Ice Cream... Think
you could help with that?

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Harvest Gathering - Finale
text.description:
Time for my final request.
Although...giving you the
final coin just like that
would be anticlimactic...
I want you to fetch me a
Carnivore Egg. They're too
heavy for me to carry them
myself.

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
And Thus, The Harvest Begins
text.description:
You've completed the two
master's requests! Your
reward will be a set of
coins used to craft a
certain piece of armor.
Oh yeah, I'm all out of
rock salt, could you go
get me some while you're
at it?

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
Golden Dash
text.description:
After years of seeking, we
reached the Tower, where
no explorer ever set foot
and survived. There we were
confronted by a gold dragon
that lashed us with powerful
light. I just hope that our
words will serve as a stark
warning of what lies ahead.

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
Silver Glide
text.description:
After years of seeking, we
reached the Tower, where
no explorer ever set foot
and survived. There we were
assailed by a silver dragon
that lashed us with powerful
light. I just hope that our
words will serve as a stark
warning of what lies ahead.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Taming the Tigrex
text.description:
You must've heard about the
unusual wyvern sighted not
so long ago. I've heard it's
form is that of the primeval
wyvernkind, and I must make
it my own. It may not be
standard practice at this
level, but I'll provide some
Supply Items to help you.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Platinum Peaks
text.description:
Among the frosty peaks,
fanged beasts of gold and
white are said to gather.
No such event has ever been
verified, but it has passed
down through hunter lore.
It's a rumor that gets the
hearts of hardcore hunters
racing.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Red Rage
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Khezu is a prime example
of the variations that occur
within a single monster type
and is easier to find than
some other unusual beasts.
Well, you may not be able to
follow my complex analysis,
but you're surely able to go
out and get those Khezu!

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Twin White Shadows
text.description:
Ever seen a Khezu in the
flesh? It's my idea of a
perfectly-formed beast.
That flavor, that juicy
meat... Umm. Anyway. You
couldn't slay a couple of
them for me, could you?

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Pink Rathian Hunt-a-thon!
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
Curious reports are coming
in of Rathians descending on
the Desert. Taking on one is
hard enough, so facing them
one after another will be
a true trial. If you seek
rare items or just want to
test your mettle, take up
the challenge!

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Speed Star
text.description:
The Guild urgently requests
that its Guild Flags take
pride of place on the summit
of the Arctic Ridge. Now,
you won't get far clad in
heavy gear like that. Supply
Items have been prepared, so
you won't need to pack any
other stuff.

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
Shadow of the Hills
text.description:
A Kut-Ku is menacing the
Verdant Hills just as a
convoy of the traders I
lead is passing through.
I need you to take care
of it fast. You'll need
to capture it, as any blood
spilled will cause other
wyverns to flock to the
scene.

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Glinting Gold
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
A Canyon Research Team has
been attacked by a Rajang.
We need you to suppress the
beast. Too easy even in that
harsh environment, huh? OK,
for research purposes, let's
limit the weapons you can
use, and have you aim for
specific body parts, too.

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Canyon Cacophony
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
A Canyon Research Team has
returned after a savage
enemy assault. The injuries
sustained suggest a Tigrex.
For research purposes, we'd
like to limit the range of
weapons at your disposal,
and have you damage specific
body parts.

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Canyon Blasting
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
A Canyon Research Team has
witnessed a huge explosion
caused by a Flaming Espinas.
For research purposes, we're
limiting the range of
weapons at your disposal,
and would ask that you try
to aim for specific body
parts.

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Canyon Inferno
text.description:
A pair of Raths has been
spotted in the Canyon. Our
research requires that
they're brought back alive,
so you'll need to capture
them. We will need most of
the items from the beasts,
but you can keep some, and
any Canyon specialties.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
The Angler's Path: Small Fry
text.description:
Fishing is a solitary
pursuit that requires
patience and dedication,
but it's an important
part of being a real Hunter.
Want to become a maestro of
the angling arts? Then get
out there and catch me
10 Speartunas!

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Pawprint Coins: Gold 1
text.description:
やあ！いつぞやはありがとう！
≪肉球のコイン≫が欲しい時
は、わるいけど峡谷まで来て
ほしい。≪クエスト達成証≫
をちゃんと持って、１人で来
てくれよ。では、峡谷で待っ
ているからね。

≪Extra Quest≫
A Tour of the Volcano (LR-2)
text.description:
It's what you've all been
waiting for! Yes, it's time
for an Extra Quest, courtesy
of the Public Tavern.
The lava lakes have been
declared safe, so you're
free to explore them to
your heart's content.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Carving Arts: Coma Sac
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster,
or complete Subquest A or B
text.description:
I often hear hunters whine
about Aberrant Monsters, and
how hard it is to get your
hands on their sacs. Well,
that's where I come in! All
you've got to do is capture
the monster. I've sprinkled
in some Subquests to make
your life easier, too. Good
luck!

text.title:
≪Premium Quest≫
Hunt the Congalala (2P)
text.description:
We've prepared the following
Quest for a party of 1 to 2
hunters. Hunt the specified
Low Rank monster to obtain a
large amount of HRP, as well
as Porta Tickets.

text.title:
≪Premium Quest≫
Hunt the Congalala (4P)
text.description:
We've prepared the following
Quest for a party of 3 to 4
hunters. Hunt the specified
Low Rank monster to obtain a
large amount of HRP, as well
as Porta Tickets.

text.title:
≪Premium Quest≫
A.Hypnocatrice Arena (2P)
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster,
or complete Subquest A
text.description:
We've prepared the following
Quest for a party of 1 to 2
hunters. Hunt the specified
Aberrant monster to obtain a
large amount of HRP, as well
as Porta Tickets.

text.title:
≪Premium Quest≫
A.Hypnocatrice Arena (4P)
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster,
or complete Subquest A
text.description:
We've prepared the following
Quest for a party of 3 to 4
hunters. Hunt the specified
Aberrant monster to obtain a
large amount of HRP, as well
as Porta Tickets.

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
Duragaua Assault
text.description:
An ice-wielding wyvern has
been spotted at the hidden
part of the Ancient Tower.
The Guild has dubbed it the
"Duragaua" and is currently
researching its ecology.
Information on it remains
scarce, and we'd like to
ask for your help with the
investigation.

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
The Frozen Tower
text.description:
According to our expedition
team, the Tower holds yet
another secret -- a secret,
secluded area. Despite the
Tower's abundant Rathalos
population, rumors say that
it is inhabited by something
else entirely -- a wyvern
clad in frozen armor. We
need you to investigate.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Darkness Unleashed
text.description:
We've received reports of
a new flying wyvern in the
Arctic Ridge. According to
witness reports, it bears
a striking resemblance to
the Belkuros. However, it
does not command lightning.
Perhaps it's a subspecies?
Go out and investigate.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Part Break: Wyvern Cortex
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster,
or complete Subquest A or B
text.description:
Here at the Mezeporta Clan
Association, we make it an
effort to reward hunters who
excel at breaking Aberrant
monster parts. Complete the
Quest to obtain a rare mate-
rial! Be advised that the
ticket used to initiate the
Quest will be lost upon
departure.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Capture: Avian Jewel
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster,
or complete Subquest A or B
text.description:
Here at the Mezeporta Clan
Association, we make it an
effort to reward hunters who
excel at capturing Aberrant
monsters. Complete the Quest
to obtain a rare material!
Be advised that the ticket
used to initiate the Quest
will be lost upon departure.

text.title:
≪Highlands Survey≫
The Brute of the Highlands
text.description:
A new, powerful monster has
been found in the Highlands.
Its fierce appearance has
earned it the nickname of
"Barbarian". We'd like to
ask you to hunt it. What do
you say? Aren't you curious
what hunting in a new land
is like?

text.title:
≪Highlands Survey≫
Grenzebul Gone Berserk
text.description:
The "Brute of the Highlands"
has been officially dubbed
as the "Grenzebul" by the
Guild. Extremely powerful,
this violent flying wyvern
has perfectly adapted to
the unique environment of
the Highlands, making it a
formidable threat. Best of
luck, hunters.

text.title:
≪Extra Quest≫
A Tour of the Canyon (HR-2)
text.description:
It's what you've all been
waiting for! Yes, it's time
for an Extra Quest, courtesy
of the Public Tavern! We've
prepared a canyon area for
you to explore. The high
ground has been declared
safe, so you're free to
explore it to your heart's
content.

text.title:
≪Extra Quest≫
A Tour of the Canyon (HR-2)
text.description:
It's what you've all been

content.

text.title:
≪Highlands Survey≫
Highlands Specialties (D)
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
I'd like to task you with
surveying the Highlands.
Unexplored lands mean only
one thing. You guessed it,
new and never-before-found
materials. Excited? I know
you are. Go out there and
get it done!

text.title:
≪Highlands Survey≫
Highlands Specialties (N)
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,

text.description:

text.title:
≪Highlands Survey≫
Highlands Wildlife (D)
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
There's nothing quite like
hunting in an unexplored
land, right? Which is why
I'd like to task you with
conducting an ecological
survey of the Highlands.
The area is currently free
of large monsters, so we'd
better strike while the
iron is hot!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Annual Benefits 1
text.description:
Thank you for being with us
for a year! Deliver a Yearly
Sub Ticket to get eleven
Gratitude Tickets! These can
be used to craft a one-of-a-
kind Great Sword, known as
the Matriarch's Blade!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Annual Benefits 2 (Empress)
text.description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Empress's Blade and deliver
a Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets II!
These can be used to craft a
one-of-a-kind Lance, known
as the "Akantor Spire"!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Annual Benefits 2 (Goddess)
text.description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Goddess's Blade and deliver
a Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets II!
These can be used to craft a
one-of-a-kind Lance, known
as the "Akantor Spire"!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Annual Benefits 3
text.description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Akantor Impaler and deliver
a Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets V!
These can be used to craft a
one-of-a-kind Hammer, known
as the "Lava Impact"!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Seeking Pawprint Coins
text.description:
I was on my way back from
the Canyon, when suddenly
I got ambushed by a pack of
Felynes & Melynxes! At this
rate, I'm never going to
make that delivery! Help me
out and I will give you a
Completion Ticket. You can
use it to get your hands on
some Pawprint Coins!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Chasing Pawprint Coins
text.description:
I was planning to go to the
Canyon, but a Basarios is
blocking the way! Help me
out, will you? I will give
you a Completion Ticket as
thanks. You can use it to
get some Pawprint Coins!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Dreaming of Pawprint Coins
text.description:
I'm in trouble! A Shogun
Ceanataur happens to be
RIGHT where I was supposed
to make a delivery! Help me
out, will you? I will give
you a Completion Ticket as
thanks. You can use it to
get some Pawprint Coins!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
The Hunt for Pawprint Coins
text.description:
I'm one step away from the
Canyon, but there's a Yian
Garuga in the way, and I
can't go any further! Help
me out, will you? I will
give you a Completion Ticket
as thanks. You can use it
to get some Pawprint Coins!

text.description:

other time. If it's Pawcoins

sure you've got the ticket.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Violent Blues
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monsters,
or complete Subquest A
text.description:
We've confirmed reports of
Aberrant Velocidrome in the
Jungle. These individuals
are extremely aggressive.
If hunting two proves too
difficult, eliminating even
one will suffice.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Vivid Reds
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monsters,
or complete Subquest A
text.description:
We've confirmed reports of
several Aberrant Iodrome in
the Marshlands. They are
extremely ferocious indivi-
duals, so please hunt two
of them if possible. If that
proves too difficult, just
one of them will do.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Egg Hunt: Yian Kut-Ku
text.description:
Hm? Goocoo Eggs? Ah right,
I lost one of them when I
was attacked by a monster
in the Jungle. It *really*
ruffled my feathers. If a
Yian Kut-Ku got it... you
might be able to snatch it
by startling it with a loud
noise. If you get it back,
it's all yours.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Egg Hunt: Congalala
text.description:
I've got a favor to ask.
A Congalala caught me by
surprise in the Marshlands
and stole my eggs! And not
just normal ones, either!
Goocoo Eggs! Get it back,
and it's all yours. Though
you'll have to pry it from 
its tail...

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Egg Hunt: Daimyo Hermitaur
text.description:
Goocoo Eggs? I bought a few
of 'em alongside other eggs,
but apparently the shipment 
has gone missing somewhere
in the Desert. I've all but
given up on it, but if you
find it, it's all yours. If
a Daimyo Hermitaur stole it,
it might just drop the egg
when switching areas...

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Goocoo Search Party
text.description:
Your feathered friend has
run off somewhere... You
want it back, right? Don't
forget your bond! If mew
look hard enough, you'll
purr-obably find some of
its memories around the
Jungle! That should do it!
I'm sure it's only a meow
away...

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Stolen Drawings
text.description:
It's a cat-astrophe! They
stole my drawings! I worked
my paws off all night, but
they've taken them all! It
must've been these thieving
Melynx! Mew've got to get
them back! Even if they're
in pieces!

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Stolen Drawings - Reprise
text.description:
Simply prepawsterous!
They've done it again! 
I worked my paws off all
night, purr-eparing new
designs for the Goocoo and
I've been robbed again!
Hunter, please, mew've got
to get them back!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Annual Benefits 4
text.description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Lava Sanctuary and deliver
a Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets IV!
These can be used to craft
exclusive Dual Blades, known
as the "Aqra Ein"!

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Egg Hunt: Basarios
text.description:
I've lost a Wyvern Egg, but
what's worse is that I lost
a Goocoo Egg too! You've got
to get it back! If Basarios
snatched it, try scaring it
out of its wits while its
hidden in the ground or
asleep! That should do it!

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Egg Hunt: Tigrex
text.description:
A Tigrex has been spotted in
the Arctic Ridge holding an
egg in its mouth. Was it a
Wyvern Egg, a Carnivore Egg,
or perhaps...a Goocoo Egg? 
Please investigate. You can
keep whatever you find. You
might be able to snatch it
by getting Tigrex stuck in
a wall...

≪Jungle Survey≫

text.description:

techniques, believed to have
been lost to time, have been
found on monsters in various
locales! If you happen to
get your hands on one, bring
it to me at once! I'll show
you what a real man can do!

Searching the Jungle
text.description:

gathering around certain
areas. Purr-haps they're on
the hunt for their favorite
food? Why don't mew go and
take a look? Don't furrget
that all you have to do is
deliver a map and purresto:
You're home!

Cuff Porkfolio: Black
text.description:

Poogie Decorations!? To
think that we've reached
the point where even they
get decorations... What?
You want me to make them
for you? A tall order...
Alright, you do a job for
me, and I'll craft them
while you're busy. Deal?

text.title:

Aberrant Assault: Hypnoc
text.description:

you would slay the fearsome
Hypnocatrice? It'll be you,
the monster, and the arena.

in it for the reward, right?
Think of the glory! Stand
tall with your comrades and
hone your hunting skills!

it for the reward, right?
Think of the glory! Stand
tall with your comrades and
hone your hunting skills!

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Mighty Vespoid Outbreak!?
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I've got used to the Great
Forest. The Vespoids too,
even large swarms. But that
one felt... different. Could
it have been one of those
Mighty varieties...? Not a
chance? Anyway, help me out
here! I saw a Hypnocatrice
too, so be careful.

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Mighty Hornetaur Outbreak!?
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Vespoids and Hornetaurs?
Not a problem. Nothing in
the Great Forest could faze
me anymore. Except one of
those giant swarms... It
was nothing like I'd ever
seen before... Do whatever
it takes to get rid of it
and get my supplies back.
And watch out for Rathian!

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Capture Craving
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Bulldrome is slain
text.description:
ヨウ！俺だよ！
毎日捕獲してるかい？捕獲は
ハンターの醍醐味のひとつだ。
今回は密林のモンスター共を
ドスンドスンと捕獲してきて
くんな。多少だが、特殊な報
酬も用意したから頑張れよ。
討伐したら当然失敗となるぜ。

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Blast Off!
text.description:
沼地で２頭のフルフル変種が
暴れているらしい。
フルフルといえば炎だよな。
そう！ガンランスであいつら
をドカンドカンと撃ち倒して
くるんだ！やり遂げれば、
俺が以前剥ぎ取ってきた皮等、
特別な報酬を出すぞ！

text.title:
≪Tidal Island Survey≫
The Tropical Fanged Beast
text.description:
熱帯の潮島を調査したところ、
未知の牙獣種が発見された
ようです。調査団によると、
上から襲ってきたとか、大き
い個体と、小さい個体がいた
とか、何かから毒を受けたと
か…。え、よくわからない？
そうですね、行って確かめて
はいかがでしょう？

text.title:
≪Tidal Island Survey≫
Leaping Guardian
text.description:
潮島で新たに発見された、
牙獣種≪ゴゴモア≫の狩猟
依頼です。熱帯の潮島という
慣れない環境での狩りとは
思いますが、こういう時こそ
ハンターさんたちの腕の見せ
どころではないでしょうか。
頑張ってきてください！

text.title:
≪Tidal Island Survey≫
T.Island Specialties (LR)
text.description:
熱帯の≪潮島≫。
ギルドでも現在調査中の、
未開の地ですが、ハンター
さんも、採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

text.title:
≪Tidal Island Survey≫
T.Island Specialties (HR)
text.description:
熱帯の≪潮島≫。
ギルドでも現在調査中の、
未開の地ですが、ハンター
さんも、採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

text.title:
≪Tidal Island Survey≫
T.Island Specialties (ER)
text.description:
熱帯の≪潮島≫。
ギルドでも現在調査中の、
未開の地ですが、ハンター
さんも、採取、調査のために
一度行ってみてはいかがで
しょうか？
帰りたくなったら地図を
納品してください！

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
White Stub Exchange (HR1)
text.description:
公式狩猟大会で優秀な成績を
収めたハンター専用の
クエストだ！
「怯まずの実」や「使い捨て
高級耳栓」など、便利なアイ
テムが手に入るぞ。
公式狩猟大会で活躍して
「ハーフチケット白」を
入手したら、ぜひ来てくれ！

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
White Stub Exchange (HR100)
text.description:
公式狩猟大会で優秀な成績を
収めたハンター専用の
クエストだ！
「剛種チケット」が、
手に入るぞ。
公式狩猟大会で活躍して
「ハーフチケット白」を
入手したら、ぜひ来てくれ！

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
White Stub Exchange (HR500)
text.description:
公式狩猟大会で優秀な成績を
収めたハンター専用の
クエストだ！
「ＨＣチケット」が、
手に入るぞ。
公式狩猟大会で活躍して
「ハーフチケット白」を
入手したら、ぜひ来てくれ！

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Unknown Usurper
text.description:
現在、謎のモンスターが、
密林にいるとの報告が
ありました。
未だ種を特定できず、
多くが謎のままですが、
新種の可能性があります。
非常に獰猛とのことなので、
危険な調査依頼となりますが、
よろしくお願いします。

text.title: ≪Jungle Survey≫Abiorg Assault
text.description:
密林で確認された≪獰竜≫
ですが、今までメゼポルタ
周辺には生息していなかった
獣竜種であることが
判明しました。
ハンターズギルドでは、
これを≪アビオルグ≫と
名付けたようです。
更なる調査をお願いします。

text.title:
≪Tidal Island Survey≫
The Island Tycoon
text.description:
One of our surveyors has
reportedly heard a strange
noise in the caverns below
the Tidal Island. Others
have reported seeing moving
rocks, and are very worried.
We may be dealing with an
unknown monster. We need
you to investigate.

text.title:
≪Tidal Island Survey≫
Guardian of the Abyss
text.description:
潮島の洞窟で新たな甲殻種が
発見されたそうです。
ハンターズギルドでは、
多殻蟹≪タイクンザムザ≫と
名付けました。
どうやら潮島で独自の進化を
遂げた甲殻種のようで、
全く形の違う２本の鎌が
特徴であるとのことです。
更なる調査をお願いします。

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
First Steps!
text.description:
うむ、我輩だ。
このクエストでは操作タイプ
の決定と、必要最低限のアド
バイス。そして我輩と共に
≪ゴゴモア≫を狩猟するぞ！
このクエストは特別に、失敗
条件を設けていない。だから
倒すまで終わらせないぞ！
よし、頑張るぞー！

text.title:
≪Rookie Quest≫
First Steps! - Reprise
text.description:
うむ、我輩だ！
このクエストは、ハンターが
初めてメゼポルタに来たら
必ず体験してもらったものと
同じ内容になっている。
しかし！報酬面は安く、ター
ゲットである≪ゴゴモア≫の
強さは強くなっているぞ。
復習も兼ねてトライだ！

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
Heaven's Gate
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
閉ざされた秘境に足を踏み入
れるには、資格が必要となる。
その資格とは≪秘境セット≫
に他ならない。
天国の門を開き、その資格を
手にした者は、閉ざされた
秘境の奥に、幸いを見つける
ことだろう･･･。

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
Open Sesame
text.description:
天に選ばれた者のみが、足を
踏み入れることを許される地、
秘境…。
忘れられた彼の地をくまなく
探索した者は、世にも珍しき
物を手にすることができるだ
ろう…。

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
A Threat Unknown
text.description:
We've received reports of
an Abiorg rampaging in the
Marshlands. There is still
much we do not know about
it, but the investigation
is slowly progressing. We
would like to ask for your
help in the matter.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Tyrannical Incursion
text.description:
We've confirmed reports of
an Abiorg in the Marshlands.
This is horrible news. The
swamps are often frequented
by rookies. Countless lives
are at stake. Now's the time
to show what you're made of.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Fiery Face-Off
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
火山で、多くのモンスターが
大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟
に出かけられる者を募りたい。
早いランクアップを目指す者
には、特にすすめるぞい。

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Sandy Showdown
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
眠鳥と砂竜が大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟
に出かけられる者を募りたい。
早いランクアップを目指す者
には、特にすすめるぞい。

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Jungle Joust
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
密林で、多くのモンスターが
大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟
に出かけられる者を募りたい。
早いランクアップを目指す者
には、特にすすめるぞい。

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Ridge Ruckus
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
雪山で、多くのモンスターが
大繁殖しておる！
各地のハンターたちに、狩猟
協力を要請しておるが、数が
多すぎるのが現実じゃ。
そこで、２人まででこの狩猟

には、特にすすめるぞい。

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Desert Drill!
text.description:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！砂漠で２頭の鳥竜と
魚竜の群れを狩猟し、仕上げ
に、洞窟より草食竜の卵を
持ち帰ってくるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Volcano Drill!
text.description:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！火山で岩竜の狩猟と、
大量のランゴスタの討伐。
そして熱い熱い火薬岩１個を
運んできて納品するんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Swamp Drill!
text.description:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！沼地で桃毛獣と、鳥竜
の群れを狩猟し、仕上げに、
洞窟より灰水晶の原石２個を
持ち帰ってくるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Arctic Drill!
text.description:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！雪山で２頭の大猪と、
雪獅子の子分達の狩猟。そし
て、支給品ボックスのギルド
フラッグを山頂に立てるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Jungle Drill!
text.description:
今回は、まだ経験の少ない
ハンター諸君限定での特訓を
行う！密林の砂浜や島で盾蟹
と桃毛獣の群れを狩猟し、
仕上げに、洞窟より肉食竜の
卵を持ち帰ってくるんだ。
厳しい特訓だが、成し遂げれ
ば諸君のハンターとしての
評価はぐっと上がるぞ！

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Fermium: Aqra Vashim
text.description:
Ancient notes about crafting
techniques, believed to have
been lost to time, have been
found on monsters in various
locales! If you happen to
get your hands on one, bring
it to me at once! I'll show
you what a real man can do!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Annual Benefits 5
text.description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Aqra Vier and deliver one
Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets V!
These can be used to craft a
special Long Sword, known as
the "Revered Talonsword"!

text.title:
≪Highlands Survey≫
Crystal Clear Revelation
text.description:
Our investigators claim to
have found a new monster in
the Highlands. It's said to
have a long neck and tail,
supple limbs, and no wings.
Its back is extremely tough,
and appears to be covered in
crystals. There's still much
we do not know. Be careful.

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Fireworks Festa!
text.description:
Hey! I've got some special
gear for 'ya. Blast away at
those monsters and show them
who's boss! I've prepared a
set of special rewards too!
Have fun!

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Great Fireworks Festa!
text.description:
Hey! I've got some special
gear for 'ya. Blast away at
those monsters and show them
who's boss! I've prepared a
set of special rewards too!
Have fun!

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Rathian Hunt-a-thon!
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
We've received a one of a
kind report about a group
of Rathian descending upon
the Desert! This Quest's
shaping up to be a hunting
marathon! If you're in need
of Rathian parts, or simply
seek a challenge, give it a
try!

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Egg Dream: Desert
text.description:
Spring has come! The stage
has been set! Can you handle
the desert sun? Countless
riches await you! If you're
looking to make it big, step
right up!

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Beastly Procession
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
A Blangonga and a Rajang
have been spotted at the
Ridge. This is quite...
unprecedented. Focus on
hunting the Blango boss
and breaking its parts.
As for Rajang... if you
could spare the time...

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Marine Blessings
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
I was out fishing, having
the time of my life, but
then a Daimyo Hermitaur and
a Plesioth came and ruined
everything! I'll give you
whatever I have left, just
get rid of that crab! I'll
handle the Plesioth. Though
don't let me stop you from
fishing it out.

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Argenite Sword & Shield
text.description:
Looking for a one-handed
Sword? I've got you! Ever
heard of Argenite? Just one
thing... The ore used to
make it is incredibly rare,
and is usually surrounded
by some nasty monsters.
Do your best and I'll take
it from there!

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
Argenite Dual Blades
text.description:
Looking for Dual Blades?
I've got you! Ever heard of
Argenite? Just one thing...
The ore used to make it is
incredibly rare, and is
usually surrounded by some
nasty monsters. Do your best
and I'll take it from there!

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Argenite Great Sword
text.description:

I've got you! Ever heard of

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Argenite Bow
text.description:
Looking for a Bow?
I've got you! Ever heard of
Argenite? Just one thing...
The ore used to make it is
incredibly rare, and is
usually surrounded by some
nasty monsters. Do your best
and I'll take it from there!

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
The Secret of the Raths
text.description:
I have studied the Raths for
many years, and my research
is all but complete. Now all
that's left for me to do, is
to study the Aberrant ones!
With that my book will be
ready! I need you to capture
both of them for me. If you
do, I'll gift you a copy.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Sandy Surprise
text.success_cond:
Hunt one of the target
monsters
text.description:
俺の角笛が欲しいってか？
うーん、金や物じゃ渡せねぇ
なぁ。どうやらいま砂漠に、
この角笛、そして俺の顔の
傷と因縁がある連中がいる
らしいから、あいつらを狩猟
して力を示してくれたら
やってもいいぞ。

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
A Battle on Two Fronts
text.description:
Once upon a time, in a land
far, far away, I'd heard a
most wonderful melody. I've
been a performer for a very
long time, but that melody
stirred my very soul. If
you manage to complete the
Quest with what I provide,
I will award you with its
score...

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Insult to Injury
text.description:
I think the Arctic Ridge may
have finally broken me. I've
been a hunter for many, many
years, but I've never felt
this horrified. I thought I
wouldn't make it. I remember
seeing a strange black metal
on my way back, but I had no
chance to look into it.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
The Rookie Carver's Trial
text.success_cond:
Capture the target monster,
and break the specified part
text.description:
師匠から急な命令があってね。
一人前の剥ぎ取り職人なら、
鎧竜変種からその尾骨を剥ぎ
取れるんで、それを取って来
て見せろとさ。捕獲と、尻尾
の切断はハンターに依頼して
いいらしいから、なんとか頼
むよ。尾骨が取れたら、師匠
に見せたあとにあげるからさ。

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Lava Dancers
text.description:
The sight of living beings
fighting for their lives...
What a thrill! How about
this -- Head to the Volcano
and hunt down a Shogun
Ceanataur. I shall reward
you with a precious, jeweled
egg. They say that there's a
fanged beast in the area,
but you can leave it be...

text.title:
≪Canyon Survey≫
Wild Dark Dancers
text.description:
峡谷の絶景を一度見たくて、
足を踏み入れたら、凶暴な
モンスターに遭遇してしまい
ました。そちらの呼び方です
と、黒狼鳥と金獅子でしょう
か。一人では太刀打ちできな
いので、先へ進めず仕方なく
戻ってきました。どうか彼ら
を退治してほしいです。

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Mystery of the Lost Ruins
text.description:
I've heard this rumor about
ancient ruins hidden in the
Marshlands. I went to go and
check them out myself, but
an Aqra Jebia stood in my
way. Think y'could get rid
of it for me? I'll give ya'
a part of the artifacts I
find as thanks.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
The Red Guard
text.description:
A certain traveler really
wants to visit the Jungle.
According to their servant,
the place is swarming with
Daimyo Hermitaur, and they
want them gone. Apparently
they're offering a special
reward... Interested?

text.title:
≪Arena Battle≫
Blue with a Hint of Blue
text.description:
Ah, right, that painting the
Guild ordered... Yes, yes,
of course. All that's left
is the Velocipreys. Oh, if
only anyone was willing to
help me capture their raw
ferocity... I'm sure the
Guild would reward them
handsomely...

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
The Hymn of the Hills
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A
text.description:
Once upon a time, in a land
far, far away, I'd heard a
most wonderful melody. I've
been a performer for a very
long time, but that melody
stirred my very soul. If
you manage to complete the
Quest with what I provide,
I will award you with its
second part...

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Honest Hammering
text.success_cond:
Hunt one of the target
monsters
text.description:
What, you want this piece
of junk? It says something
about upgrading armor. I
could do it, but not for a
wimp like you... How bout'
ya get some more experience
first. Forging's all about
fire, a bit of clink, and a
whole lotta clang. Got it?

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Proof of Patience
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A or B
text.description:
Stunning medallion, right?
If you work hard, you too
can make something like it.
Patience is a virtue for
artisans and hunters alike.
If you can show me just how
patient you really are, it's
all yours.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Bird-brained Beatdown
text.description:
Aim for the head, strike,
strike, and strike again!
Those are the fundamentals
of hunting. If you want to
get your hands on this rare
bone, take my beloved gear
and bash some birds in!

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Pink & Poisonous Peril
text.description:
An Aberrant Gypceros and
Congalala seem to be causing
quite the ruckus around the
Jungle. Please hunt them as
soon as possible. You will
be rewarded with a special
emblem provided to us by
the Guild.

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
Verdant Hills Reprisal
text.description:
I was out gathering in the
Verdant Hills, when a pair
of Rathalos attacked! I've
saved my skin, but I can't
just stand by and let them
wreak havoc. Can you handle
it? I'll give ya' a Sturdy
Jawbone in return.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Dark Wolf, Dark Stars
text.success_cond:
Hunt the target monster, or
complete Subquest A or B
text.description:
I saw it! A bona fide meteor
shower! You may be able to
find traces of them around
the Jungle. I hear there's
a Garuga in the area though,
so be careful!

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Desert Crown
text.success_cond:
Slay the Aqra Vashim, and
hunt the Gendrome
text.description:
I was ambushed by a color-
shifting scorpion! What's
worse, I dropped my precious
book... If you've got the
time, could you please look
for it? Still, the crystals
on that critter were one-of-
a-kind. I'd love to add some
to my costume...

text.title:
≪Great Forest Survey≫
Hypnocatrice Hysteria
text.description:
Have ya' been to the Great
Forest lately? It's full of
them blue birds now, right?
Could you bring me their
feathers? What!? It's the
wrong season!? Oh well, an
orange one will do too!
Don't overthink it kiddo!
Just go!

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Black Bastion
text.description:
A pair of old Black Gravios
has appeared in the swamp.
Considering their age and
huge bodies... They could
probably devour all the ore
in the area! Is there any
brave soul ready to take
them out?

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Annual Benefits 2 (Sovereign)
text.description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Sovereign's Blade, deliver
a Yearly Sub Ticket, and
get your hands on a set of
eleven Gratitude Tickets II!
These can be used to craft a
one-of-a-kind Lance, known
as the "Akantor Spire"!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Annual Benefits 3-2
text.description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Akantor Warn and deliver a
Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets V!
These can be used to craft a
one-of-a-kind Hammer, known
as the "Lava Impact"!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Annual Benefits 4-2
text.description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Great Lavasioth and deliver
a Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets IV!
These can be used to craft
exclusive Dual Blades, known
as the "Aqra Ein"!

text.title:
≪Special Event Quest≫
Annual Benefits 5-2
text.description:
Thank you for being with us
for another year! Equip the
Aqra Zehn and deliver one
Yearly Sub Ticket to get
eleven Gratitude Tickets V!
These can be used to craft a
special Long Sword, known as
the "Revered Talonsword"!

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
Trickster
text.description:
The Chameleos is an outcast
among the Elder Dragons. It
is so rare that, even now,
many question its existence!
Trying to capture it is no
use. You'd best concentrate
on steadily hammering away
instead.

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
The Phantom Beast
text.description:
この地の彼方に眠る、謎多き
未開の地≪古塔≫に、幻獣≪
キリン≫が現れたようね。
古塔へはいつでも行けるわけ
ではなく、天候や気候を始め
とする環境が安定してる期間
だけ…、今しかないようね。

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
Forest Gobbler
text.description:
謎多き狩猟地≪古塔≫にて、
山が動くとの奇妙な話が届い
ておる…。ワシの推測が的中
すれば、ちと厄介な事態にな
りそうなのじゃ。事態が暗転
する前にその真実を確かめ、
話が誠ならば討伐を頼むぞ！

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
The Ravaging Rainstorm
text.description:
The Kushala Daora is a
different monster from
anything you've hunted this
far. Its very presence can
transform rain into a storm.
Capturing it is a waste of
time, so concentrate on
steadily hammering away
at it instead.

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
A Jungle Veiled by Mist
text.description:
The Chameleos is an outcast
among the elder dragons.
It's almost as if the Jungle
rain is on his side, as it
grows more intense when he's
nearby. Trying to capture
him is a waste of time, so
concentrate on steadily
hammering away instead.

text.title:
≪Desert Survey≫
Blazing Hot Sands
text.description:
The Teostra is an elder
dragon said to be an avatar
of the inferno. Its ferocity
puts it in a terrifying
class all its own. Don't
even think about trying to
capture it, just hammer
away and wear it down.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Creeping Menace
text.description:
The Chameleos is an outcast
among the Elder Dragons. It
is capable of vanishing in
a flash, making it feared
even by the most elite of
hunters. Trying to capture
it is no use. Concentrate
on steadily hammering away
instead.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
A Muddy Audience
text.description:
The Teostra is said to be an
avatar of the inferno. Its
fiery cloak will mercilessly
sap away at your Health at
close range... You have no
hope of capturing it. Focus
on steadily wearing it down
instead.

text.title:
≪Ancient Tower Survey≫
Shocking Silver
text.description:
古龍種に属される≪キリン≫
は、特定の生息域を持たない
うえにその個体数の少なさか
ら≪幻獣≫とも呼ばれる生き
物ね。過酷な環境もものとも
しない適応力から、属性の類
は、ほとんど通用しないみた
いだから気をつけてね。

text.title:
≪Arctic Ridge Survey≫
Lord of the Storm
text.description:
The Kushala Daora is far
removed from any monster
you've hunted this far.
It will likely throw your
own powerlessness into
stark relief. Don't even
try to capture it, focus
on steadily wearing it
down instead.

text.title:
≪Volcano Survey≫
Sparks Dancing in the Blaze
text.description:
The Teostra is said to be an
avatar of the inferno, with
all the fire and heat of the
Volcano at its command. You
have no hope of capturing
it, so concentrate instead
on steadily hammering away.

text.title:
≪Marshlands Survey≫
Teostra Investigation
text.description:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

text.title:
≪Verdant Hills Survey≫
Chameleos Investigation
text.description:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

text.title:
≪Jungle Survey≫
Kushala Daora Investigation
text.description:
自分もそろそろ古龍の研究が
やってみたいんだ。捕獲でき
ないのはよくわかっている。
だが、なんとか研究しやすい
ように、各部位を破壊した上
での討伐をお願いできないだ
ろうか？部位を破壊せずに
討伐した場合は失敗とさせて
もらうよ。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Preparation is Key
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
腹減った…。さっき食べた
ばかりだけど、腹が減った。
悪いけど、オレにこんがり肉
を分けてくれないか？礼なら
ちゃんとするぜ。その代わり
生焼けやコゲ肉なんかじゃ、
満足しないぜ。じゃー頼んだ
よ。あぁ、腹減ったなぁ。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Memories of the Exam
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or Integrity hits 0
text.description:
アイツに会ったのは、公式狩
猟試験以来だったかな。しば
らく、ぬるま湯の生活に慣れ
ちまったオレもダメなんだが、
アイツは半端なしに強いぜ。
あんたも、腕試しのつもりで
行ってみたらどうだい？
ま、その腕が鈍っていなけれ
ばの話だがな。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
A Protection Job
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
今回は猟団員の皆様に挑戦状
ですニャ。このクエストは、
サブターゲットにステキな報
酬を用意させていただいた
ニャ。でも、メインターゲッ
トは簡単に達成できてしまう
ので、時にはアイルーを守る
ことも必要かも知れないです
ニャ。健闘を祈りますニャ。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Rajang Marathon
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
オレは目を疑ったね。だって
あの≪ラージャン≫が２頭も
いるんだぜ？おちおち採掘な
んてしていられなかったよ。
でもさ、あの火山って、いい
採掘ポイントがいくつかある
んだよね。…なぁ、頼むから
あんた達でなんとかあいつら
をやっつけてくれないかい。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Confluence of Tigrex
text.description:
今回も猟団員の皆様に、クエ
ストを用意させていただいた
ニャ。今度はアイツが、２頭
同時で登場しているニャ。
サブターゲットクリアは用意
していないので、準備をしっ
かりして、猟団員の皆様で力
を合わせて頑張ってください
ニャ。健闘を祈りますニャ。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Fungal Feud
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
あの形…あのツヤ…あの香り
…。あんなキノコ、なかなか
お目にかかれないのに、あの
野郎ときたら、オレの目の前
でパクッと食べやがった。
そこでだ！オレが依頼するの
は、そのキノコを食べたアイ
ツ≪モス≫を倒して欲しいっ
てことだ。頼んだぜ。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Noxious Nap
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
この前、突然眠くなってきた
んで、あれっと思って辺りを
見たら≪ヒプノック≫の仕業
だったね。正直参ったよ。
おまけに≪ガブラス≫もいる
もんだから、眠るし毒だしで、
生きて帰れないかと焦ったよ。
あそこに行くんだったら気を
つけて行くんだな。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Pursuit of Power
text.description:
Yo! I really want to get
stronger, but I think I've
hit a wall. No matter how
hard I try, I just can't
hunt the Gypceros or the
Khezu. I'd like you to give
it a shot too! You'll see
just how hard it can really
get.

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Handle With Care!
text.success_cond:
メインターゲット、もしくは
サブターゲットＡかＢの達成
text.description:
最近、卵料理に凝り始めちゃ
ってね。おかげで卵がいくら
あっても足りないんだよな。
だから頼む！オレに≪草食竜
の卵≫を６個運んできてくれ
ないか？礼は用意してあるか
ら安心してくれ。無用の長物
かもしれないがな。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Bright and White
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
あんた達、雪山の採掘ポイン
トを知っているかい？なかな
かいい所あるだろ？なのによ、
オレがピッケルを使うと、必
ず奴らが来るんだよね。どう
にかならねぇかなぁ…。
あ、≪フルベビ漬け≫を納品
してくれたら、礼するぜ。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Hot, Hot, Hot!
text.description:
おッス。今回は火山で汗をか
きながら自分自身を鍛えてい
たッス。そしたら出たッス。
正直、しんどいッス。だけど
この先に明日が見えるに違い
ないッス。なので猟団のみな
さんにも挑戦して欲しいッス。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Dreamy Duet?
text.description:
今回も明るい猟団生活を送っ
てもらうために、クエストを
用意させていただいたニャ。
住む世界の異なる２頭が、大
闘技場で夢の共演ですニャ。
猟団員の皆様で、力を合わせ
て頑張ってくださいニャ。
健闘を祈りますニャ。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Tigrex Rampage
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
大変ですニャ！あの《ティガ
レックス》が雪山で大暴れし
ているそうですニャ！今回は
危険なので、ＨＲ７１以上の
ハンターさんにお願いしてい
るニャ。サブターゲットもあ
るので、そちらも挑戦しても
らえると嬉しいですニャ。

text.title: ≪Clan Quest≫
text.description:
おっス。今日は夜の砂漠で、
寒さに耐えながら特訓ッス。
自分で目標決めて挑んだッス
が、まだまだダメッス。この
時間以内に倒せないッス。
そこで猟団のみなさんだった
らどうかと思って依頼してみ
たッス。どうッスか？

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Today's Big Haul!
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
I think I'm up against the
biggest hunting challenge
of my life. I mean -- two
Plesioth? In the Desert!?
I bet even you'd struggle
with this one. If you're
up for the challenge, feel
free to play it safe and
start with the Subquest.

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
A Hot Date
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
火山ってイイよね。採掘には
全く飽きない場所だよ。だけ
どさ、あのポイントには近づ
けられないんだよ。アイツが
いるからなんだよね。どうに
かしてくれねぇかなぁ…。
掘りたいんだよなぁ…。
な、頼むよ。礼はするから。

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Ready, Set, BOOM!
text.description:
I've just finished crafting
a special item for another
customer, but honestly, I
haven't even tried it yet.
Why don't you lot help me?
I'll leave it in the Supply
Box. Don't be fooled, it'll
be just like the real deal.
Counting on you.

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Shakalaka Shakedown
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
こ、これは大変ですニャ！
森丘に《チャチャブー》の奴
等がたくさん来たですニャ！
しかも…あ、あの飛竜達も
大暴れしているニャ！
ここはみなさん、落ち着いて
準備してから出発してくだ
さいですニャ！

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
The Jungle's Lone Wolf?
text.description:
He's finally shown up.
Boldly appearing alone --
just him and me, face to
face in a true showdown.
As for how it ended... heh.
That doesn't matter. More
importantly, I'll tell you
WHERE it happened. You all
should go see it for your-
selves.

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Crabs-a-plenty
text.description:
Yo! I'm currently out honing
my skills in the swamp. It's
been going pretty well, but
after failing and failing...
I don't think I'm ready yet.
So I thought: "maybe a Clan
could help me out?" And...
here we are. So, how about
it?

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Long Horns?
text.description:
The Desert mining spots are
so good. But those horned
menaces, and their absurdly
loud roars, make it hard to
appreciate them... Can you
maybe do something about it?
I'm begging you...

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Lean, Mean & Green
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
The Great Forest is, well...
great. Its greenery almost
feels therapeutic... but
not THAT type of greenery!
Especially the spiky kind!
That one's better off dead!
Please hunt them down for
me.

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Rocks, Lava, Danger!
text.description:
I think I'm up against the
biggest hunting challenge
of my life. There's that
sneaky rock, and then that
blazing hot fish... And they
want me to hunt TWO of them?
I just can't do it... It's
hopeless! You get me, right?
Right...?

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
When the Magic Happens
text.description:
I saw two Hypnocatrice
wooing each other in the
Great Forest! And here I
am, still single... Blast
those da... Wait, I know!
The Forest is in danger,
yes! You need to hunt
them to keep the peace!

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Ridge Ruckus
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
Calm down! Listen to me!
We've received reports of
two meownsters in the Arctic
Ridge! Your targets are: The
fearsome Rajang, and a fur-
rightening Tigrex! If that's
too much to handle, hunting
one of them is fine too! I
couldn't even blame mew...

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Returning the Favor?
text.fail_cond:
Reward hits 0, time expires,
or 5 Mosswine are slayed
text.description:
A group of Mosswine seem to
be taking on a Black Gravios
all by themselves. It must
have wrecked their favorite
mushroom-munching spot. I'd
know something about that...
That's why I've got a favor
to ask. You've got to help
them slay that thing!

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
The Crab Cabal?
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Jungle? Seriously great.
The mining spots? Amazing.
I'm seriously excited, but
something's out of place.
What's up with the ruckus
on the beach, anyway? It's
like a bunch of underlings
following their boss. Can
you... clean up a little?

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
A Night With the Blossoms
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A
text.description:
This Quests is filled with
cherry-colored meownsters.
They may remind mew of our
wonderful cherry trees, but
make no mistake, things can
get pretty... stinky. Best
of luck!

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
For the Love of the Marsh
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
The Marshlands... Yeah, I
love 'em. But there's that
red, poison-spitting nasty,
and then that weirdo that
feels like it's there one
moment, and gone another!
How am I supposed to focus
on mining!? Anyway, that's
where you come in. Thanks.

text.title:
≪Clan Quest≫
Spare Me the Cold
text.success_cond:
Complete Main Objective,
or Subquest A or B
text.description:
I know I shouldn't be asking
for this, but I need you to
go to the Arctic Ridge and
get me a few items, alright?
You probably need the pelts
anyway. Why don't I do it
myself...? Are you sure you
wanna know? Well...
